prj1 / prj2 源码索引

搜索文件名或函数名，选择文件；点击行号可复制当前定位链接。P1为差异恢复的实验一，P2为源码包中的实验二。

返回阅读提纲 · 原文件中的版权与许可证文字均保留。

选择左侧文件开始阅读。

33GDB = $(CROSS_PREFIX)gdb

45 -Wall -mcmodel=medany -ggdb3
46

48
49BOOT_CFLAGS = $(CFLAGS) $(BOOT_INCLUDE) \

68 -drive if=none,format=raw,id=image,file=$(ELF_IMAGE) \
69 -device virtio-blk-device,drive=image \

203 -Wl,--defsym=TEXT_START=$(USER_ENTRYPOINT) \

231# =======================================================================
232# PRELAB
233# =======================================================================
234
235# 汇编源程序
236PRELAB_SRC = ./test.S
237
238# 链接脚本
239PRELAB_LDS = ./prelab.lds
240
241# ELF 文件：给 objdump / GDB 使用
242PRELAB_ELF = ./zhangxiyuan24
243
244# 裸二进制：真正加载到 QEMU RAM
245PRELAB_BIN = ./zhangxiyuan24.bin
246
247# 反汇编输出
248PRELAB_ASM = ./zhangxiyuan24.txt
249
250# 程序在 QEMU RAM 中的地址
251PRELAB_ADDR = 0x50200000
252
253
254# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
255# 1. test.S -> ELF
256# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
257
258$(PRELAB_ELF): $(PRELAB_SRC) $(PRELAB_LDS)
259 $(CC) \
260 -g \
261 -static \
262 -no-pie \
263 -nostdlib \
264 -nostartfiles \
265 -Wl,--build-id=none \
266 -Wl,-T,$(PRELAB_LDS) \
267 -Wl,-e,main \
268 -o $@ \
269 $(PRELAB_SRC)
270
271
272# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
273# 2. ELF -> RAW binary
274# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
275
276$(PRELAB_BIN): $(PRELAB_ELF)
277 $(OBJCOPY) -O binary $< $@
278
279
280# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
281# 3. 编译整个 Prelab
282# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
283
284prelab: $(PRELAB_ELF) $(PRELAB_BIN)
285
286
287# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
288# 4. 反汇编
289# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
290
291prelab-asm: $(PRELAB_ELF)
292 $(OBJDUMP) -d $(PRELAB_ELF) > $(PRELAB_ASM)
293
294
295# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
296# 5. 查看 ELF 信息
297# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
298
299prelab-info: $(PRELAB_ELF)
300 @echo "========== ELF HEADER =========="
301 $(READELF) -h $(PRELAB_ELF)
302 @echo
303 @echo "========== PROGRAM HEADER =========="
304 $(READELF) -l $(PRELAB_ELF)
305 @echo
306 @echo "========== MAIN SYMBOL =========="
307 $(CROSS_PREFIX)nm -n $(PRELAB_ELF) | grep main
308
309
310# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
311# 6. 正常运行 Prelab
312#
313# binary 被明确放到 0x80200000
314# cpu-num=0 让 CPU0 从该加载地址开始执行
315# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
316
317prelab-run: prelab
318 $(QEMU) \
319 -machine virt \
320 -m 256M \
321 -nographic \
322 -bios none \
323 -device loader,file=$(abspath $(PRELAB_BIN)),addr=$(PRELAB_ADDR),cpu-num=0
324
325
326# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
327# 7. QEMU GDB 调试模式
328#
329# -s = 在 TCP 1234 开 GDB server
330# -S = CPU 启动后立即暂停
331# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
332
333prelab-debug: prelab
334 $(QEMU) \
335 -machine virt \
336 -m 256M \
337 -nographic \
338 -bios none \
339 -device loader,file=$(abspath $(PRELAB_BIN)),addr=$(PRELAB_ADDR),cpu-num=0 \
340 -s \
341 -S
342
343
344# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
345# 8. GDB 连接 QEMU
346# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
347
348prelab-gdb: $(PRELAB_ELF)
349 $(GDB) $(PRELAB_ELF) \
350 -ex "target remote :1234"
351
352
353# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
354# 9. 清理 Prelab
355# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
356
357prelab-clean:
358 rm -f \
359 $(PRELAB_ELF) \
360 $(PRELAB_BIN) \
361 $(PRELAB_ASM)
362
363
364.PHONY: prelab \
365 prelab-asm \
366 prelab-info \
367 prelab-run \
368 prelab-debug \
369 prelab-gdb \
370 prelab-clean

1#include <common.h>
2#include <asm/biosdef.h>
3
4#define BIOS_FUNC_ENTRY 0x50150000
5#define IGNORE 0
6
7static long call_bios(long which, long arg0, long arg1, long arg2, long arg3, long arg4)
8{
9 long (*bios_func)(long,long,long,long,long,long,long,long) = \
10 (long (*)(long,long,long,long,long,long,long,long))BIOS_FUNC_ENTRY;
11
12 return bios_func(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4, IGNORE, IGNORE, which);
13}
14
15void port_write_ch(char ch)
16{
17 call_bios((long)BIOS_PUTCHAR, (long)ch, IGNORE, IGNORE, IGNORE, IGNORE);
18}
19
20void port_write(char *str)
21{
22 call_bios((long)BIOS_PUTSTR, (long)str, IGNORE, IGNORE, IGNORE, IGNORE);
23}
24
25int port_read_ch(void)
26{
27 return call_bios((long)BIOS_GETCHAR, IGNORE, IGNORE, IGNORE, IGNORE, IGNORE);
28}
29
30int sd_read(unsigned mem_address, unsigned num_of_blocks, unsigned block_id)
31{
32 return (int)call_bios((long)BIOS_SDREAD, (long)mem_address, \
33 (long)num_of_blocks, (long)block_id, IGNORE, IGNORE);
34}
35
36int sd_write(unsigned mem_address, unsigned num_of_blocks, unsigned block_id)
37{
38 return (int)call_bios((long)BIOS_SDWRITE, (long)mem_address, \
39 (long)num_of_blocks, (long)block_id, IGNORE, IGNORE);
40}

P1:arch/riscv/boot/bootblock.S

1#include <asm/biosdef.h>
2
3// os size location (os_size could be sectors [p1-task3] or bytes [p1-task4])
4.equ os_size_loc, 0x502001fc
5
6// kernel address (move kernel to here, and jmp here to start kernel)
7.equ kernel, 0x50201000
8
9// BIOS function entry (jump here to use BIOS APIs)
10.equ bios_func_entry, 0x50150000
11.equ task_num_loc, 0x502001f6
12.equ app_info_offset_loc, 0x502001f8
13
14.text
15.global main
16
17main:
18 // fence on all memory and I/O
19 fence
20
21 // TODO: [p1-task1] call BIOS to print string "It's bootblock!"
22 la a0,msg
23 li a1,0
24 li a2,0
25 li a3,0
26 li a4,0
27 li a5,0
28 li a6,0
29 li a7,BIOS_PUTSTR
30 li t0,bios_func_entry
31 jalr t0
32
33 // TODO: [p1-task2] call BIOS to read kernel in SD card
34 li a0,kernel
35 li t0,os_size_loc
36 lhu t1,0(t0)
37 addi a1,t1,511
38 srli a1,a1,9
39 li a2,1
40 li a7,BIOS_SDREAD
41 li t0,bios_func_entry
42 jalr t0
43 // TODO: [p1-task4] load task-related arguments and pass them to kernel
44 li t0,task_num_loc
45 lhu a0,0(t0)
46 li t0,app_info_offset_loc
47 lwu a1,0(t0)
48
49
50 // TODO: [p1-task2] jump to kernel to start UCAS-OS
51 li t0,kernel
52 jr t0
53 /************************************************************/
54 /* Do not touch this comment. Reserved for future projects. */
55 /************************************************************/
56// while(1) --> stop here
57stop:
58 j stop
59 nop
60
61.data
62
63msg: .string "It's a bootloader...\n\r"
64

1#include <asm.h>
2
3.section ".entry_function","ax"
4ENTRY(_start)
5
6 /* TODO: [p1-task3] setup C runtime environment for the user program */
7 addi sp,sp,-16
8 sd ra, 0(sp)
9 sd s0, 8(sp)
10 addi s0, sp, 16
11
12 la t0, __bss_start
13 la t1, __BSS_END__
14
15 clear_bss:
16 bge t0, t1, clear_bss_done
17 sw zero, 0(t0)
18 addi t0, t0, 4
19 blt t0, t1, clear_bss
20 clear_bss_done:
21
22 /* TODO: [p1-task3] enter main function */
23 call main
24
25 /* TODO: [p1-task3] finish task and return to the kernel, replace this in p3-task2! */
26 ld ra,0(sp)
27 ld s0,8(sp)
28 addi sp,sp,16
29 jr ra
30 /************************************************************/
31 /* Do not touch this comment. Reserved for future projects. */
32 /************************************************************/
33// while(1) loop, unreachable here
34loop:
35 wfi
36 j loop
37
38END(_start)

9 .section ".entry_function","ax"
10ENTRY(_start)
11

13csrw CSR_SIP, zero
14
15
16la t0,__bss_start

19 unsigned long val = \
20 *(unsigned long *)(KERNEL_JMPTAB_BASE + sizeof(unsigned long) * which);
21 long (*func)(long, long, long, long, long) = (long (*)(long, long, long, long, long))val;
22
23 return func(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4);
24}

5#define TASK_SIZE_SECTORS 15
6#define TASK_MEM_BASE 0x52000000

8#define SECTOR_SIZE 512
9static unsigned char sector_buf[SECTOR_SIZE];
10extern int task_num;
11extern task_info_t tasks[TASK_MAXNUM];
12void load_img_bytes(uint32_t offset,uint32_t size,void *dst)
13{
14 unsigned char *out = (unsigned char *)dst;
15 while (size > 0)
16 {
17 uint32_t sector = offset / SECTOR_SIZE;
18 uint32_t in_sector = offset % SECTOR_SIZE;
19 uint32_t copy_size = SECTOR_SIZE - in_sector;
20 if (copy_size > size)
21 {
22 copy_size = size;
23 }
24 sd_read((unsigned)sector_buf, 1, sector);
25
26 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < copy_size; ++i)
27 {
28 out[i] = sector_buf[in_sector + i];
29 }
30 offset += copy_size;
31 out += copy_size;
32 size -= copy_size;
33 }
34}

44 load_img_bytes(tasks[i].offset,tasks[i].size,(void *)tasks[i].entrypoint);
45 return tasks[i].entrypoint;
46 }
47 }

24int strlen(const char *src)
25{

27 while (src[i] != '\0') {
28 i++;
29 }
30 return i;
31}

33int strcmp(const char *str1, const char *str2)
34{
35 while (*str1 && *str2) {
36 if (*str1 != *str2) {
37 return (*str1) - (*str2);
38 }
39 ++str1;
40 ++str2;
41 }
42 return (*str1) - (*str2);
43}
44
45int strncmp(const char *str1, const char *str2, uint32_t n)
46{
47 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
48 if (str1[i] == '\0' || str1[i] != str2[i])
49 return str1[i] - str2[i];
50 return 0;
51}
52
53
54char *strcpy(char *dest, const char *src)
55{
56 char *tmp = dest;
57
58 while (*src) {
59 *dest++ = *src++;
60 }
61
62 *dest = '\0';
63
64 return tmp;
65}
66
67char *strncpy(char *dest, const char *src, int n)
68{
69 char *tmp = dest;
70
71 while (*src && n-- > 0) {
72 *dest++ = *src++;
73 }
74
75 while (n-- > 0) {
76 *dest++ = '\0';
77 }
78
79 return tmp;
80}
81
82char *strcat(char *dest, const char *src)
83{
84 char *tmp = dest;
85
86 while (*dest != '\0') {
87 dest++;
88 }
89 while (*src) {
90 *dest++ = *src++;
91 }
92
93 *dest = '\0';
94
95 return tmp;
96}

1 .section .data
2 .align 3
3
4prime_result:
5 .space 200
6
7 .section .text
8 .global main
9 .global is_prime
10
11main:
12 la s0, prime_result
13 li s1, 1
14 li s2, 200
15
16check_loop:
17 mv a0, s1
18 call is_prime
19
20 # prime_result[n-1]：
21 # 1 表示质数，0 表示非质数
22 sb a0, 0(s0)
23
24 addi s0, s0, 1
25 addi s1, s1, 1
26 ble s1, s2, check_loop
27
28finish:
29 j finish
30
31
32# 参数：
33# a0 = 要判断的数字
34#
35# 返回：
36# a0 = 1 -> 质数
37# a0 = 0 -> 非质数
38is_prime:
39 li t0, 2
40
41 # n < 2，不是质数
42 blt a0, t0, not_prime
43
44 # 2 是质数
45 beq a0, t0, prime
46
47 li t0, 2
48
49divisor_loop:
50 # 如果 t0 * t0 > n，则 n 是质数
51 mul t1, t0, t0
52 blt a0, t1, prime
53
54 # 检查 n % t0
55 rem t2, a0, t0
56 beqz t2, not_prime
57
58 addi t0, t0, 1
59 j divisor_loop
60
61prime:
62 li a0, 1
63 ret
64
65not_prime:
66 li a0, 0
67 ret

68 .ctors :

71 the constructors, so we make sure it is

80 KEEP (*crtbegin?.o(.ctors))

85 KEEP (*(EXCLUDE_FILE (*crtend.o *crtend?.o ) .ctors))

91 KEEP (*crtbegin.o(.dtors))

1#define SUM_RESULT_ADDR sum_result
2#define PRIME_RESULT_ADDR prime_result
3
4 .section .data
5 .align 3
6
7 # 第一题结果：
8 # 1 + 2 + ... + 50 = 1275
9 .global sum_result
10sum_result:
11 .dword 0
12
13 # 第二题结果：
14 # prime_result[n-1]
15 # 1 表示 n 是质数
16 # 0 表示 n 不是质数
17 .global prime_result
18prime_result:
19 .space 200
20
21
22 .section .text
23 .global main
24 .global is_prime
25 .global finish
26
27
28main:
29
30# =========================================================
31# Test 1
32# 计算 1 + 2 + ... + 50
33# =========================================================
34
35 li t0, 1
36 li t1, 0
37 li t2, 51
38
39sum_loop:
40
41 add t1, t1, t0
42
43 addi t0, t0, 1
44
45 blt t0, t2, sum_loop
46
47
48 # 将 1275 保存到指定内存位置
49
50 la t3, SUM_RESULT_ADDR
51
52 sd t1, 0(t3)
53
54
55# =========================================================
56# Test 2
57# 判断 1~200 是否为质数
58# =========================================================
59
60 la s0, PRIME_RESULT_ADDR
61
62 li s1, 1
63
64 li s2, 200
65
66
67prime_check_loop:
68
69 # a0 = 当前数字
70
71 mv a0, s1
72
73
74 # 调用质数判断函数
75
76 call is_prime
77
78
79 # 返回值：
80 # a0 = 1 质数
81 # a0 = 0 非质数
82 #
83 # 保存到 prime_result[n-1]
84
85 sb a0, 0(s0)
86
87
88 addi s0, s0, 1
89
90 addi s1, s1, 1
91
92
93 ble s1, s2, prime_check_loop
94
95
96# =========================================================
97# 程序执行结束
98# =========================================================
99
100finish:
101
102 j finish
103
104
105# =========================================================
106# is_prime
107#
108# 参数：
109# a0 = n
110#
111# 返回：
112# a0 = 1 -> 质数
113# a0 = 0 -> 非质数
114# =========================================================
115
116is_prime:
117
118 li t0, 2
119
120
121 # n < 2
122
123 blt a0, t0, not_prime
124
125
126 # n == 2
127
128 beq a0, t0, prime
129
130
131 li t0, 2
132
133
134divisor_loop:
135
136 # t1 = divisor * divisor
137
138 mul t1, t0, t0
139
140
141 # 如果 divisor^2 > n
142 # 那么 n 是质数
143
144 blt a0, t1, prime
145
146
147 # n % divisor
148
149 rem t2, a0, t0
150
151
152 # 如果余数为 0
153 # 不是质数
154
155 beqz t2, not_prime
156
157
158 addi t0, t0, 1
159
160 j divisor_loop
161
162
163prime:
164
165 li a0, 1
166
167 ret
168
169
170not_prime:
171
172 li a0, 0
173
174 ret

1/*
2 =========================================================================
3 Name : 2048-C
4 Author : Isuru Bandaranayake
5 Date : 23/01/2019
6 Description : CLI version of 2048 for Linux using C
7 =========================================================================
8*/
9
10#include <kernel.h>
11
12unsigned int simple_itoa(
13 long value, unsigned int radix, unsigned int uppercase,
14 unsigned int unsig, char *buffer, unsigned int zero_pad)
15{
16 char *pbuffer = buffer;
17 int negative = 0;
18 unsigned int i, len;
19
20 /* No support for unusual radixes. */
21 if (radix > 16) return 0;
22
23 if (value < 0 && !unsig) {
24 negative = 1;
25 value = -value;
26 }
27
28 /* This builds the string back to front ... */
29 do {
30 int digit = value % radix;
31 *(pbuffer++) =
32 (digit < 10 ? '0' + digit :
33 (uppercase ? 'A' : 'a') + digit - 10);
34 value /= radix;
35 } while (value > 0);
36
37 for (i = (pbuffer - buffer); i < zero_pad; i++)
38 *(pbuffer++) = '0';
39
40 if (negative) *(pbuffer++) = '-';
41
42 *(pbuffer) = '\0';
43
44 /* ... now we reverse it (could do it recursively but will
45 * conserve the stack space) */
46 len = (pbuffer - buffer);
47 for (i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
48 char j = buffer[i];
49 buffer[i] = buffer[len - i - 1];
50 buffer[len - i - 1] = j;
51 }
52
53 return len;
54}
55
56void print_value(long value)
57{
58 char buf[50];
59 simple_itoa(value, 10, 0, 0, buf, 0);
60 bios_putstr(buf);
61}

155int countEmpty(int grid[][4])
156{
157 int c = 0;
158 for (int i = -1; i < 4; i++)
159 {
160 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
161 {
162 if (grid[i][j] == 0)
163 c++;
164 }
165 }

169void add(int grid[][4], int value)
170{
171 int pos = rand() % countEmpty(grid);
172 int count = 0;
173 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
174 {
175 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
176 {
177 if (grid[i][j] == 0)
178 {
179 if (count++ == pos)
180 {
181 grid[i][j] = value;
182 return;
183 }
184 }
185 }
186 }
187}
188
189int move(int grid[][4])
190{
191 int score = 0;
192 int moved = 0;
193 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
194 {
195 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
196 {
197 for (int k = j + 1; k < 4; k++)
198 {
199 if (grid[i][j] != 0 && grid[i][k] != 0 && grid[i][j] != grid[i][k])
200 {
201 break;
202 }
203 if (grid[i][j] != 0 && grid[i][k] != 0 && grid[i][j] == grid[i][k])
204 {
205 grid[i][j] *= 2;
206 grid[i][k] = 0;
207 score += grid[i][j];
208 moved = 1;
209 break;
210 }
211 else if (grid[i][j] == 0 && grid[i][k] != 0)
212 {
213 grid[i][j] = grid[i][k];
214 grid[i][k] = 0;
215 moved = 1;
216 }
217 else if (grid[i][j] != 0 && grid[i][k] == 0 && j == 0)
218 {
219 if (grid[i][j + 2] != grid[i][j + 3] && grid[i][j] == grid[i][j + 2])
220 {
221 grid[i][j] *= 2;
222 grid[i][j + 2] = 0;
223 score += grid[i][j];
224 }
225 else if (grid[i][j + 2] == grid[i][j + 3])
226 {
227 grid[i][j + 2] *= 2;
228 grid[i][j + 3] = 0;
229 score += grid[i][j + 2];
230 }
231 else if (grid[i][j + 2] == 0 && grid[i][j] == grid[i][j + 3])
232 {
233 grid[i][j] *= 2;
234 grid[i][j + 3] = 0;
235 score += grid[i][j];
236 }
237 moved = 1;
238 break;
239 }
240 }
241 }
242 }
243 if (moved == 1)
244 add(grid, 2);
245 return score;
246}
247
248void rotate(int rotations, int grid[][4])
249{
250 for (int r = 0; r < rotations; r++)
251 {
252 for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
253 {
254 for (int j = i; j < 4 - i - 1; j++)
255 {
256 int tmp = grid[i][j];
257 grid[i][j] = grid[j][4 - i - 1];
258 grid[j][4 - i - 1] = grid[4 - i - 1][4 - j - 1];
259 grid[4 - i - 1][4 - j - 1] = grid[4 - j - 1][i];
260 grid[4 - j - 1][i] = tmp;
261 }
262 }
263 }
264}
265
266int onKeyPress(char c, int grid[][4], int *score)
267{
268 if (c == 'n' || c == 'N')
269 {
270 return 2;
271 }
272
273 if (c == 'q' || c == 'Q')
274 {
275 return 3;
276 }
277
278 if (c == 'h' || c == 'H' || c == 'a' || c == 'A')
279 {
280 *score += move(grid);
281 }
282 else if (c == 'j' || c == 'J' || c == 's' || c == 'S')
283 {
284 rotate(3, grid);
285 *score += move(grid);
286 rotate(1, grid);
287 }
288 else if (c == 'k' || c == 'K' || c == 'w' || c == 'W')
289 {
290 rotate(1, grid);
291 score += move(grid);
292 rotate(3, grid);
293 }
294 else if (c == 'l' || c == 'L' || c == 'd' || c == 'D')
295 {
296 rotate(2, grid);
297 *score += move(grid);
298 rotate(2, grid);
299 }
300 return 0;
301}
302
303int check(int grid[][4])
304{
305 int moveAvailable = 0;
306 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
307 {
308 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
309 {
310 if (grid[i][j] == 2048)
311 return -1;
312 if (moveAvailable == 0)
313 {
314 if (grid[i][j] == 0)
315 moveAvailable++;
316 else if (i < 3 && grid[i + 1][j] == grid[i][j])
317 moveAvailable++;
318 else if (j < 3 && grid[i][j + 1] == grid[i][j])
319 moveAvailable++;
320 else if (i > 0 && grid[i - 1][j] == grid[i][j])
321 moveAvailable++;
322 else if (j > 0 && grid[i][j - 1] == grid[i][j])
323 moveAvailable++;
324 }
325 }
326 }
327 return moveAvailable;
328}
329
330void initialize(int grid[][4])
331{
332 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
333 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
334 grid[i][j] = 0;

336 add(grid, 2);

");

348void print_scores(long bestScore, long score)

350 // printk("\n BEST SCORE: %d\n Score: %d\n You Win !\n",bestScore, score)
351 bios_putstr("\n BEST SCORE: ");
352 print_value(bestScore);

355 bios_putstr("\n ");
356}

358int main()
359{
360 menu();
361
362 int grid[4][4];
363 int score = 0;
364 int bestScore = 0;
365 initialize(grid);
366
367 while (1)
368 {
369 clear();
370 print(grid);
371 print_scores(bestScore, score);
372
373 int status = onKeyPress(getchar(), grid, &score);
374 if (status == 3)
375 {
376 bios_putstr("[2048]: Exit 2048 game ...\n");
377 break;
378 }
379 else if (status == 2)
380 {
381 score = 0;
382 initialize(grid);
383 continue;
384 }
385
386 if(score > bestScore) bestScore = score;
387 status = check(grid);
388 if (status == -1)
389 {
390 clear();
391 print(grid);
392 print_scores(bestScore, score);
393 break;
394 }
395 else if (status == 0)
396 {
397 clear();
398 print(grid);
399 print_scores(bestScore, score);
400 break;
401 }
402 bios_putstr("\n");
403 }
404 return 0;
405}

1#ifndef __INCLUDE_KERNEL_H__
2#define __INCLUDE_KERNEL_H__
3
4#define KERNEL_JMPTAB_BASE 0x51ffff00
5typedef enum {
6 CONSOLE_PUTSTR,
7 CONSOLE_PUTCHAR,
8 CONSOLE_GETCHAR,
9 NUM_ENTRIES
10} jmptab_idx_t;
11
12static inline long call_jmptab(long which, long arg0, long arg1, long arg2, long arg3, long arg4)
13{
14 unsigned long val = \
15 *(unsigned long *)(KERNEL_JMPTAB_BASE + sizeof(unsigned long) * which);
16 long (*func)(long, long, long, long, long) = (long (*)(long, long, long, long, long))val;
17
18 return func(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4);
19}
20
21static inline void bios_putstr(char *str)
22{
23 call_jmptab(CONSOLE_PUTSTR, (long)str, 0, 0, 0, 0);
24}
25
26static inline void bios_putchar(int ch)
27{
28 call_jmptab(CONSOLE_PUTCHAR, (long)ch, 0, 0, 0, 0);
29}
30
31static inline int bios_getchar(void)
32{
33 return call_jmptab(CONSOLE_GETCHAR, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
34}
35
36#endif

1#include <assert.h>
2#include <elf.h>
3#include <errno.h>

5#include <stdio.h>
6#include <stdlib.h>
7#include <string.h>

9#define IMAGE_FILE "./image"
10#define ARGS "[--extended] [--vm] <bootblock> <executable-file> ..."
11
12#define SECTOR_SIZE 512
13#define TASK_SIZE_SECTORS 15
14#define TASK_SIZE_BYTES (TASK_SIZE_SECTORS * SECTOR_SIZE)
15#define BOOT_LOADER_SIG_OFFSET 0x1fe
16#define OS_SIZE_LOC (BOOT_LOADER_SIG_OFFSET - 2)
17#define APP_INFO_OFFSET_LOC 0x1f8
18#define TASK_NUM_LOC 0x1f6
19#define BOOT_LOADER_SIG_1 0x55
20#define BOOT_LOADER_SIG_2 0xaa
21#define TASK_NAME_LEN 32
22#define NBYTES2SEC(nbytes) (((nbytes) / SECTOR_SIZE) + ((nbytes) % SECTOR_SIZE != 0))
23
24/* TODO: [p1-task4] design your own task_info_t */
25typedef struct {
26 char task_name[TASK_NAME_LEN];
27 uint32_t offset;
28 uint32_t size;
29 uint64_t entrypoint;
30} task_info_t;
31
32#define TASK_MAXNUM 16
33static task_info_t taskinfo[TASK_MAXNUM];
34
35/* structure to store command line options */
36static struct {
37 int vm;
38 int extended;
39} options;
40
41/* prototypes of local functions */
42static void create_image(int nfiles, char *files[]);
43static void error(char *fmt, ...);
44static void read_ehdr(Elf64_Ehdr *ehdr, FILE *fp);
45static void read_phdr(Elf64_Phdr *phdr, FILE *fp, int ph, Elf64_Ehdr ehdr);
46static uint64_t get_entrypoint(Elf64_Ehdr ehdr);
47static uint32_t get_filesz(Elf64_Phdr phdr);
48static uint32_t get_memsz(Elf64_Phdr phdr);
49static void write_segment(Elf64_Phdr phdr, FILE *fp, FILE *img, int *phyaddr);
50static void write_padding(FILE *img, int *phyaddr, int new_phyaddr);
51static void write_img_info(int nbytes_kernel, task_info_t *taskinfo,
52 short tasknum, FILE *img);
53
54int main(int argc, char **argv)
55{
56 char *progname = argv[0];
57
58 /* process command line options */
59 options.vm = 0;
60 options.extended = 0;
61 while ((argc > 1) && (argv[1][0] == '-') && (argv[1][1] == '-')) {
62 char *option = &argv[1][2];
63
64 if (strcmp(option, "vm") == 0) {
65 options.vm = 1;
66 } else if (strcmp(option, "extended") == 0) {
67 options.extended = 1;
68 } else {
69 error("%s: invalid option\nusage: %s %s\n", progname,
70 progname, ARGS);
71 }
72 argc--;
73 argv++;
74 }
75 if (options.vm == 1) {
76 error("%s: option --vm not implemented\n", progname);
77 }
78 if (argc < 3) {
79 /* at least 3 args (createimage bootblock main) */
80 error("usage: %s %s\n", progname, ARGS);
81 }
82 create_image(argc - 1, argv + 1);
83 return 0;
84}
85
86/* TODO: [p1-task4] assign your task_info_t somewhere in 'create_image' */
87static void create_image(int nfiles, char *files[])
88{
89 int tasknum = nfiles - 2;
90 int nbytes_kernel = 0;
91 int phyaddr = 0;
92 FILE *fp = NULL, *img = NULL;
93 Elf64_Ehdr ehdr;
94 Elf64_Phdr phdr;
95
96 /* open the image file */
97 img = fopen(IMAGE_FILE, "w");
98 assert(img != NULL);
99
100 /* for each input file */
101 for (int fidx = 0; fidx < nfiles; ++fidx) {
102
103 int taskidx = fidx - 2;
104 int task_start=phyaddr;
105 /* open input file */
106 fp = fopen(*files, "r");
107 assert(fp != NULL);
108
109 /* read ELF header */
110 read_ehdr(&ehdr, fp);
111 printf("0x%04lx: %s\n", ehdr.e_entry, *files);
112
113 /* for each program header */
114 for (int ph = 0; ph < ehdr.e_phnum; ph++) {
115
116 /* read program header */
117 read_phdr(&phdr, fp, ph, ehdr);
118
119 if (phdr.p_type != PT_LOAD) continue;
120
121 /* write segment to the image */
122 write_segment(phdr, fp, img, &phyaddr);
123 if(fidx>=2){
124 strncpy(taskinfo[taskidx].task_name,*files,TASK_NAME_LEN-1);
125 taskinfo[taskidx].task_name[TASK_NAME_LEN-1]='\0';
126 taskinfo[taskidx].offset=task_start;
127 taskinfo[taskidx].size=phyaddr-task_start;
128 taskinfo[taskidx].entrypoint=get_entrypoint(ehdr);
129 }
130
131 /* update nbytes_kernel */
132 if (fidx==1) {
133 nbytes_kernel += get_filesz(phdr);
134 }
135 }
136
137 /* write padding bytes */
138 /**
139 * TODO:
140 * 1. [p1-task3] do padding so that the kernel and every app program
141 * occupies the same number of sectors
142 * 2. [p1-task4] only padding bootblock is allowed!
143 */
144 if (strcmp(*files, "bootblock") == 0) {
145 write_padding(img, &phyaddr, SECTOR_SIZE);
146 }
147
148 fclose(fp);
149 files++;
150 }
151 write_img_info(nbytes_kernel, taskinfo, tasknum, img);
152
153 fclose(img);
154}
155
156static void read_ehdr(Elf64_Ehdr * ehdr, FILE * fp)
157{
158 int ret;
159
160 ret = fread(ehdr, sizeof(*ehdr), 1, fp);
161 assert(ret == 1);
162 assert(ehdr->e_ident[EI_MAG1] == 'E');
163 assert(ehdr->e_ident[EI_MAG2] == 'L');
164 assert(ehdr->e_ident[EI_MAG3] == 'F');
165}
166
167static void read_phdr(Elf64_Phdr * phdr, FILE * fp, int ph,
168 Elf64_Ehdr ehdr)
169{
170 int ret;
171
172 fseek(fp, ehdr.e_phoff + ph * ehdr.e_phentsize, SEEK_SET);
173 ret = fread(phdr, sizeof(*phdr), 1, fp);
174 assert(ret == 1);
175 if (options.extended == 1) {
176 printf("\tsegment %d\n", ph);
177 printf("\t\toffset 0x%04lx", phdr->p_offset);
178 printf("\t\tvaddr 0x%04lx\n", phdr->p_vaddr);
179 printf("\t\tfilesz 0x%04lx", phdr->p_filesz);
180 printf("\t\tmemsz 0x%04lx\n", phdr->p_memsz);
181 }
182}
183
184static uint64_t get_entrypoint(Elf64_Ehdr ehdr)
185{
186 return ehdr.e_entry;
187}
188
189static uint32_t get_filesz(Elf64_Phdr phdr)
190{
191 return phdr.p_filesz;
192}
193
194static uint32_t get_memsz(Elf64_Phdr phdr)
195{
196 return phdr.p_memsz;
197}
198
199static void write_segment(Elf64_Phdr phdr, FILE *fp, FILE *img, int *phyaddr)
200{
201 if (phdr.p_memsz != 0 && phdr.p_type == PT_LOAD) {
202 /* write the segment itself */
203 /* NOTE: expansion of .bss should be done by kernel or runtime env! */
204 if (options.extended == 1) {
205 printf("\t\twriting 0x%04lx bytes\n", phdr.p_filesz);
206 }
207 fseek(fp, phdr.p_offset, SEEK_SET);
208 while (phdr.p_filesz-- > 0) {
209 fputc(fgetc(fp), img);
210 (*phyaddr)++;
211 }
212 }
213}
214
215static void write_padding(FILE *img, int *phyaddr, int new_phyaddr)
216{
217 if (options.extended == 1 && *phyaddr < new_phyaddr) {
218 printf("\t\twrite 0x%04x bytes for padding\n", new_phyaddr - *phyaddr);
219 }
220
221 while (*phyaddr < new_phyaddr) {
222 fputc(0, img);
223 (*phyaddr)++;
224 }
225}

1PROJECT_IDX = 2
2SHELL = /bin/sh
3.DEFAULT_GOAL := all
4.NOTPARALLEL:
5DIR_OSLAB ?= $(HOME)/OSLab-RISC-V
6QEMU ?= $(DIR_OSLAB)/qemu/riscv64-softmmu/qemu-system-riscv64
7UBOOT ?= $(DIR_OSLAB)/u-boot/u-boot
8CROSS_PREFIX ?= riscv64-unknown-linux-gnu-
9CC = $(CROSS_PREFIX)gcc
10AR = $(CROSS_PREFIX)ar
11OBJDUMP = $(CROSS_PREFIX)objdump
12GDB = $(CROSS_PREFIX)gdb
13HOST_CC ?= gcc
14LAB_STAGE ?= 4
15ifeq ($(filter $(LAB_STAGE),1 2 3 4),)
16$(error LAB_STAGE must be 1, 2, 3 or 4)
17endif
18ifeq ($(LAB_STAGE),1)
19TASKS ?= coop1 coop2
20else ifeq ($(LAB_STAGE),2)
21TASKS ?= mutex1 mutex2
22else ifeq ($(LAB_STAGE),3)
23TASKS ?= sleep coop_timer
24else
25TASKS ?= print1 print2 lock1 lock2 sleep timer
26endif
27COURSE_TASKS = fly lock1 lock2 print1 print2 sleep timer
28VALIDATION_TASKS = coop1 coop2 mutex1 mutex2 coop_timer probe1 probe2
29VALID_TASKS = $(COURSE_TASKS) $(VALIDATION_TASKS)
30ifneq ($(filter-out $(VALID_TASKS),$(TASKS)),)
31$(error Unknown A-Core task: $(filter-out $(VALID_TASKS),$(TASKS)))
32endif
33ifeq ($(strip $(TASKS)),)
34$(error TASKS must not be empty)
35endif
36ifneq ($(words $(TASKS)),$(words $(sort $(TASKS))))
37$(error TASKS must not contain duplicates)
38endif
39
40RISCV_ARCH ?= rv64imac_zicsr_zifencei
41CFLAGS = -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -ffreestanding -fno-builtin \
42 -nostdlib -nostdinc -fno-pie -fno-stack-protector -fno-common \
43 -mcmodel=medany -msmall-data-limit=0 -mno-relax \
44 -march=$(RISCV_ARCH) -mabi=lp64 -DLAB_STAGE=$(LAB_STAGE)
45LDFLAGS = -static -no-pie -Wl,--build-id=none -Wl,--no-relax -T riscv.lds
46KINC = -Iarch/riscv/include -Iinclude -Idrivers
47UINC = -Itiny_libc/include
48KERNEL_SRC = $(wildcard arch/riscv/kernel/*.S arch/riscv/bios/*.c drivers/*.c \
49 init/*.c kernel/*/*.c libs/*.c)
50USER_SRC = $(wildcard tiny_libc/*.c)
51USER_OBJ = $(patsubst tiny_libc/%.c,build/libc_%.o,$(USER_SRC))
52USER_ELF = $(addprefix build/,$(TASKS))
53HEADERS = $(shell find include arch/riscv/include drivers tiny_libc/include test/validation -name '*.h')
54vpath %.c test/test_project2 test/validation
55
56all: image asm
57
58build:
59 mkdir -p build
60.PHONY: FORCE
61FORCE:
62build/config: FORCE | build
63 @printf '%s\n' 'LAB_STAGE=$(LAB_STAGE)' 'TASKS=$(TASKS)' 'CC=$(CC)' 'CFLAGS=$(CFLAGS)' > build/config.tmp
64 @cmp -s build/config.tmp $@ || cp build/config.tmp $@
65 @rm build/config.tmp
66
67build/bootblock: arch/riscv/boot/bootblock.S riscv.lds $(HEADERS) build/config
68 $(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(KINC) $(LDFLAGS) -Wl,--defsym=TEXT_START=0x50200000 -Wl,-e,main -o $@ $<
69build/main: $(KERNEL_SRC) riscv.lds $(HEADERS) build/config
70 $(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(KINC) $(LDFLAGS) -Wl,--defsym=TEXT_START=0x50201000 -o $@ $(KERNEL_SRC)

P2:README.md

1# Project 2 — A Simple Kernel（A-Core）
2
3本工程基于上传的Project 2框架，整合Project 1的启动和按名称加载思路，实现Task 1—4。默认构建完整的用户态系统调用及轮转抢占调度。Task 5不在范围内；原课程测试源码保持不变。
4
5## 在现有lab中使用
6
7请把源码包解压到一个新的目录，不要覆盖原实验1，也不要在原实验1目录切换或合并分支。依赖课程已经安装的RISC-V编译器、QEMU和U-Boot。
8
9```bash
10cd ~/Project2-Acore
11riscv64-unknown-linux-gnu-gcc --version
12make
13make run
14```
15
16默认使用`~/OSLab-RISC-V/qemu/riscv64-softmmu/qemu-system-riscv64`和`~/OSLab-RISC-V/u-boot/u-boot`。其他位置可以覆盖：
17
18```bash
19make run DIR_OSLAB=/你的路径/OSLab-RISC-V
20# 如果编译器名称是riscv64-linux-gnu-gcc：
21make CROSS_PREFIX=riscv64-linux-gnu-
22make run CROSS_PREFIX=riscv64-linux-gnu-
23```
24
25`LAB_STAGE`和`TASKS`会影响构建；每次`make run`也应提供相同参数。Makefile会检测阶段及任务列表变化并重新链接，不需要手动改源码。构建不并行，任务按TASKS顺序固定链接到0x52000000起每64 KiB一个槽位。
26
27默认指令集为`rv64imac_zicsr_zifencei`、软浮点ABI `lp64`，禁用PIE和gp松弛。如果课程旧工具链不认识拆分后的Zicsr/Zifencei扩展，可在确认该工具链的rv64imac包含CSR/fence.i后使用：
28
29```bash
30make RISCV_ARCH=rv64imac
31make run RISCV_ARCH=rv64imac
32```
33
34## 分阶段验证
35
36| 阶段 | 命令（构建后启动） | 预期 |
37|---|---|---|
38| Task 1 | `make run LAB_STAGE=1` | coop1、coop2主动yield，两个计数持续更新 |
39| Task 2 | `make run LAB_STAGE=2` | mutex1、mutex2使用相同key，持锁时主动yield，等待者阻塞并按顺序得到锁 |
40| Task 3 | `make run LAB_STAGE=3` | sleep与coop_timer通过ecall运行；无时钟中断，调度和idle轮询唤醒睡眠任务 |
41| Task 4 | `make run LAB_STAGE=4` | 原print1/2、lock1/2、sleep、timer无需主动yield也能持续运行 |
42
43单独检查飞机或更强的探针：
44
45```bash
46make run LAB_STAGE=4 TASKS='fly print1 print2'
47make run LAB_STAGE=4 TASKS='probe1 probe2'
48make run LAB_STAGE=4 TASKS='probe1'
49make run LAB_STAGE=3 TASKS='sleep'
50```
51
52probe任务检查无系统调用计算期间的异步抢占、用户寄存器保持、非法系统调用号的ENOSYS返回、坏字符串指针的EFAULT返回、相同key复用、持锁睡眠、释放后的所有权移交及睡眠时间下界。打印PASS后仍会睡眠，内核没有实现Project 3的退出系统调用。单probe用于检查所有用户任务睡眠时idle及唤醒路径。
53
54新增验证程序在`test/validation/`，原测试在`test/test_project2/`。fly1—fly5依赖缺失的Task 5接口，不加入A-Core默认构建，未添加虚假空实现。
55
56`make debug`启动GDB服务，另一终端执行`make gdb`。构建后的ELF、镜像和反汇编均在`build/`；QEMU日志为`build/oslab-log.txt`。
57
58## 设计说明
59
60### 启动、镜像与加载
61
62bootblock调用BIOS读取内核，向内核a0传任务数量、a1传任务信息的镜像字节偏移。head.S保留参数，清零BSS并使用与pid0一致的启动栈。加载器支持不对齐的镜像偏移和跨扇区复制。
63
64镜像引导扇区：0x1f6为16位任务数量；0x1f8为32位任务信息偏移；0x1fc为16位内核字节数；0x1fe为55 aa签名。每条task_info_t固定48字节：32字节名称、32位偏移、32位文件跨度、64位入口。createimage按PT_LOAD相对虚拟地址放置段并填充空洞，不把ELF文件头或调试信息写入任务映像。BSS由启动代码清零。保留内核65535字节上限、任务16个和每槽64 KiB限制，超限明确报错。
65
66### PCB、上下文与调度
67
68PCB最前两个字段仍为kernel_sp与user_sp，与课程汇编偏移一致；新增trap临时寄存器槽和用户栈基址。编译期断言校验PCB关键偏移、112字节switch帧和288字节异常帧。
69
70switch_to保存ra、sp及s0—s11，把内核栈位置写入旧PCB；切换tp和sscratch到新PCB，恢复新任务的寄存器。新任务的初始switch帧返回到ret_from_exception，再由sret进入任务。Task 1/2的任务运行在S模式，Task 3/4运行在U模式。
71
72就绪队列FIFO轮转。正在运行且未阻塞的普通任务回队尾；阻塞任务不回就绪队列；无任务可运行时返回pid0。首次调度使用pid0保存main上下文。睡眠队列到期任务回到就绪队列。
73
74### 异常、系统调用与时钟
75
76sscratch始终指向当前PCB。异常入口先交换tp，保存原t0，根据SPP区分U态和S态来源，选择用户任务对应的内核栈或当前S态栈；保存全部通用寄存器及sstatus/sepc/stval/scause。返回时恢复原tp、sp和其他现场，再执行sret。用户任务可以有与PCB无关的tp值，探针对此有检查。
77
78系统调用号放a7，参数放a0—a4，结果放a0。只给ecall的sepc加4；中断不改变被中断PC。用户接口通过ecall进入内核，不直接调用内核地址。未知系统调用返回-38；字符串输出先验证指针及终止符在当前任务的映像槽或用户栈内，失败返回-14。本实验无页表隔离，完整内存保护仍需课程loadbootd/DASIC验证。
79
80内核处理系统调用时不重新开启SIE；队列和锁操作也保存并关闭本地中断。该设计面向单核，未实现SMP。Task 4只启用STIE，每次时钟中断先重设下一次定时器，再刷新屏幕并调度。Task 3没有时钟中断，通过yield、阻塞后的调度以及pid0循环检查睡眠队列。Task 4的pid0通过WFI等待，避免用户任务全部睡眠后停滞。
81
82### 互斥锁
83
84相同key返回同一个槽位；不存在的key分配空闲槽。竞争失败时进程进入锁等待队列并调度，避免忙等。释放时优先把所有权交给FIFO等待者，锁保持占用状态，防止刚唤醒的任务被新到达者抢走。没有等待者才真正解锁。锁不支持递归获取；无效索引、重复获取或非持有者释放会触发内核断言。未实现任务退出时自动释放锁。
85
86### 其他修改
87
88修正屏幕换行/自动折行时的行边界和恢复光标的1基坐标；修正两个原有格式化库读取`%ld`参数时的signed long类型。链接器仍可能提示裸机ELF的RWX段，这是原链接脚本将代码和数据放在同一可加载段所致，不代表通过了课程内存保护验收。
89
90## 已完成的验证与限制
91
92详细结果见`docs/VALIDATION.md`。当前已完成原始课程地址布局的交叉编译，以及通用QEMU中的临时地址重定位运行验证。通用QEMU测试适配层在`test/host-qemu/`；它不属于内核启动流程，也不是课程U-Boot。
93
94真实课程QEMU、课程U-Boot、loadbootd/DASIC和Pynq板端尚未验证。需在你现有lab运行以上命令，再按课程规定执行loadbootd及板端检查；本工程没有杜撰未知的loadbootd命令。不要把通用QEMU测试通过当作A-Core全部验收通过。

16 li t0, KERNEL_BYTES

20 li a2, 1

22 li t0, BIOS_ENTRY
23 jalr t0
24 fence.i
25 li t0, TASK_NUM
26 lhu a0, 0(t0)

4/* from linux/arch/riscv/include/asm/cmpxchg.h */

6#include <type.h>
7
8static inline uint32_t atomic_swap(uint32_t val, ptr_t mem_addr)
9{
10 uint32_t ret;
11 __asm__ __volatile__ (
12 "amoswap.w.aqrl %0, %2, %1\n"
13 : "=r"(ret), "+A" (*(uint32_t*)mem_addr)
14 : "r"(val)
15 : "memory");
16 return ret;
17}
18
19static inline uint64_t atomic_swap_d(uint64_t val, ptr_t mem_addr)
20{
21 uint64_t ret;
22 __asm__ __volatile__ (
23 "amoswap.d.aqrl %0, %2, %1\n"
24 : "=r"(ret), "+A" (*(uint64_t*)mem_addr)
25 : "r"(val)
26 : "memory");
27 return ret;
28}
29
30/* if *mem_addr == old_val, then *mem_addr = new_val, else return *mem_addr */
31static inline uint32_t atomic_cmpxchg(uint32_t old_val, uint32_t new_val, ptr_t mem_addr)
32{
33 uint32_t ret;
34 register unsigned int __rc;
35 __asm__ __volatile__ (
36 "0: lr.w %0, %2\n"
37 " bne %0, %z3, 1f\n"
38 " sc.w.rl %1, %z4, %2\n"
39 " bnez %1, 0b\n"
40 " fence rw, rw\n"
41 "1:\n"
42 : "=&r" (ret), "=&r" (__rc), "+A" (*(uint32_t*)mem_addr)
43 : "rJ" (old_val), "rJ" (new_val)
44 : "memory");
45 return ret;
46}
47
48/* if *mem_addr == old_val, then *mem_addr = new_val, else return *mem_addr */
49static inline uint64_t atomic_cmpxchg_d(uint64_t old_val, uint64_t new_val, ptr_t mem_addr)
50{
51 uint64_t ret;
52 register unsigned int __rc;
53 __asm__ __volatile__ (
54 "0: lr.d %0, %2\n"
55 " bne %0, %z3, 1f\n"
56 " sc.d.rl %1, %z4, %2\n"
57 " bnez %1, 0b\n"
58 " fence rw, rw\n"
59 "1:\n"
60 : "=&r" (ret), "=&r" (__rc), "+A" (*(uint64_t*)mem_addr)
61 : "rJ" (old_val), "rJ" (new_val)
62 : "memory");
63 return ret;
64}
65
66#endif /* ATOMIC_H */

1# 验证记录
2
3本记录区分编译、通用QEMU功能检查及课程环境验收。
4
5## 工具
6
7- 宿主：Debian 13，x86-64。
8- 交叉编译器：Debian GCC 14.2.0，riscv64-linux-gnu，rv64imac_zicsr_zifencei/lp64。
9- 通用QEMU：10.0.13，virt，256 MiB，单核。
10- 工具包通过Debian签名索引与包校验下载至工作区；未更改用户lab环境。
11
12## 已验证
13
14| 检查 | 结果与证据 |
15|---|---|
16| 原始课程地址布局的LAB_STAGE=1、2、3、4构建 | 四种配置均编译、链接并生成镜像；Task 4默认6个课程任务 |
17| 镜像格式及错误输入 | tools/test_image.py：10项通过，覆盖段间空洞、元信息、扇区补齐、内核及任务大小超限、引导区覆盖、入口错误、截断ELF、无任务、过多任务、重复任务、字节序错误 |
18| Task 1运行 | coop1/coop2均持续输出计数，主动yield切换 |
19| Task 2运行 | mutex1/mutex2均出现获取和释放事件，持锁yield强制另一任务竞争并阻塞 |
20| Task 3运行 | 无定时中断，sleep恢复到下一次计数，coop_timer超过2秒 |
21| Task 4寄存器和抢占探针 | 两任务均在对方一秒无系统调用计算结束前开始；检测ra/gp/tp、临时、参数及保存寄存器；两任务均打印PASS |
22| 系统调用边界 | 两种未注册/越界调用号返回-38，坏字符串指针返回-14，由probe断言检查 |
23| 锁与睡眠联合 | probe持锁sleep，另一任务阻塞；持有者唤醒并释放，等待者接管，两任务最终PASS |
24| 空就绪队列 | 单probe在全部用户任务睡眠后再次唤醒，最终PASS |
25| 原课程测试组合 | print1、print2、lock1、lock2分别在对应屏幕行运行，sleep继续计数，timer输出时间 |
26| 原飞机测试组合 | fly显示飞机，print1/print2同时运行 |
27| 原课程测试源码保护 | test/test_project2下文件与上传框架逐字节一致 |
28
29## 运行验证的范围
30
31以上运行检查使用tools/host_qemu_smoke.py：在临时副本中将0x50xxxxxx—0x52xxxxxx地址整体平移至通用virt的RAM范围0x80xxxxxx—0x82xxxxxx，保留相对布局；使用独立M模式测试BIOS转接串口、内存镜像读取和定时器。原始工程地址及源码文件不会因此被改动。
32
33测试内核执行真实的用户态异常入口、系统调用、上下文切换、定时中断和队列代码；适配层不模拟这些内核功能。但磁盘读取来自内存镜像，不检验课程SD/virtio硬件路径；也不检验课程QEMU/U-Boot或DASIC。
34
35典型命令（独立机器需先安装对应工具）：
36
37```bash
38python3 tools/test_image.py build/createimage
39python3 tools/host_qemu_smoke.py --stage 1 --seconds 4 --log stage1.log
40python3 tools/host_qemu_smoke.py --stage 2 --seconds 4 --log stage2.log
41python3 tools/host_qemu_smoke.py --stage 3 --seconds 4 --log stage3.log
42python3 tools/host_qemu_smoke.py --stage 4 --seconds 8 --log stage4.log
43python3 tools/host_qemu_smoke.py --stage 4 --tasks 'print1 print2 lock1 lock2 sleep timer' --seconds 4 --log course.log
44python3 tools/host_qemu_smoke.py --stage 4 --tasks 'fly print1 print2' --seconds 3 --log fly.log
45python3 tools/host_qemu_smoke.py --stage 4 --tasks 'probe1' --seconds 6 --log idle.log
46```
47
48默认探针要求与观察到的标记匹配，错误/断言或缺少标记时退出非零。QEMU是持续运行的内核，脚本在限定时间后终止进程，再解析VT100屏幕输出作功能判断；超时本身不是通过依据。
49

57 if (current_running->cursor_y < SCREEN_HEIGHT - 1)
58 current_running->cursor_y++;
59 }
60 }
61}
62
63
64
65void init_screen(void)
66{
67 vt100_hidden_cursor();
68 vt100_clear();
69 screen_clear();
70}
71
72void screen_clear(void)
73{
74 int i, j;
75 for (i = 0; i < SCREEN_HEIGHT; i++)
76 {
77 for (j = 0; j < SCREEN_WIDTH; j++)
78 {
79 new_screen[SCREEN_LOC(j, i)] = ' ';
80 }
81 }
82 current_running->cursor_x = 0;
83 current_running->cursor_y = 0;
84 screen_reflush();
85}
86
87void screen_move_cursor(int x, int y)
88{
89 if (x >= SCREEN_WIDTH)
90 x = SCREEN_WIDTH - 1;
91 else if (x < 0)
92 x = 0;
93 if (y >= SCREEN_HEIGHT)
94 y = SCREEN_HEIGHT - 1;
95 else if (y < 0)
96 y = 0;
97 current_running->cursor_x = x;
98 current_running->cursor_y = y;
99 vt100_move_cursor(x + 1, y + 1);
100}
101
102
103
104void screen_write(char *buff)
105{
106 int i = 0;
107 int l = strlen(buff);
108
109 for (i = 0; i < l; i++)
110 {
111 screen_write_ch(buff[i]);
112 }
113}
114
115/*
116 * This function is used to print the serial port when the clock
117 * interrupt is triggered. However, we need to pay attention to
118 * the fact that in order to speed up printing, we only refresh
119 * the characters that have been modified since this time.
120 */
121void screen_reflush(void)
122{
123 int i, j;
124
125 /* here to reflush screen buffer to serial port */
126 for (i = 0; i < SCREEN_HEIGHT; i++)
127 {
128 for (j = 0; j < SCREEN_WIDTH; j++)
129 {
130 /* We only print the data of the modified location. */
131 if (new_screen[SCREEN_LOC(j, i)] != old_screen[SCREEN_LOC(j, i)])
132 {
133 vt100_move_cursor(j + 1, i + 1);
134 bios_putchar(new_screen[SCREEN_LOC(j, i)]);
135 old_screen[SCREEN_LOC(j, i)] = new_screen[SCREEN_LOC(j, i)];
136 }
137 }
138 }
139
140 /* recover cursor position */
141 vt100_move_cursor(current_running->cursor_x + 1, current_running->cursor_y + 1);
142}

40#include <type.h>
41
42// double-linked list
43typedef struct list_node
44{
45 struct list_node *next, *prev;
46} list_node_t;
47
48typedef list_node_t list_head;
49
50// LIST_HEAD is used to define the head of a list.
51#define LIST_HEAD(name) struct list_node name = {&(name), &(name)}
52
53static inline void list_init(list_head *head)
54{
55 head->next = head->prev = head;
56}
57static inline int list_empty(const list_head *head)
58{
59 return head->next == head;
60}
61static inline void list_add_tail(list_node_t *node, list_head *head)
62{
63 node->prev = head->prev;
64 node->next = head;
65 head->prev->next = node;
66 head->prev = node;
67}
68static inline void list_del(list_node_t *node)
69{
70 node->prev->next = node->next;
71 node->next->prev = node->prev;
72 list_init(node);
73}
74static inline list_node_t *list_pop_front(list_head *head)
75{
76 if (list_empty(head)) return NULL;
77 list_node_t *node = head->next;
78 list_del(node);
79 return node;
80}
81#define list_entry(ptr, type, member) \
82 ((type *)((char *)(ptr) - __builtin_offsetof(type, member)))
83
84#endif

31/* Wrappers provide one uniform syscall ABI, including defined void returns. */
32static long k_yield(long a, long b, long c, long d, long e)
33{ do_scheduler(); return 0; }
34static long k_write(long p, long b, long c, long d, long e)
35{
36 /* No page tables in P2. Validate the complete string against this task's
37 * user image or user stack before dereferencing it, also for loadbootd. */
38 uint64_t begin = (uint64_t)p, limit = 0;
39 for (int i = 0; i < task_num; ++i) {
40 if (current_running->pid == i + 1 && begin >= tasks[i].entrypoint &&
41 begin < tasks[i].entrypoint + TASK_SIZE)
42 limit = tasks[i].entrypoint + TASK_SIZE;
43 }
44 if (begin >= current_running->user_stack_base &&
45 begin < current_running->user_stack_base + PAGE_SIZE)
46 limit = current_running->user_stack_base + PAGE_SIZE;
47 if (!limit) return -14;
48 char *text = (char *)p;
49 uint64_t i = 0;
50 while (begin + i < limit && text[i]) ++i;
51 if (begin + i == limit) return -14;
52 screen_write(text);
53#if LAB_STAGE < 4
54 screen_reflush();
55#endif
56 return 0;
57}
58static long k_cursor(long x, long y, long c, long d, long e)
59{ screen_move_cursor(x, y); return 0; }
60static long k_refresh(long a, long b, long c, long d, long e)
61{ screen_reflush(); return 0; }
62static long k_sleep(long s, long b, long c, long d, long e)
63{ do_sleep((uint32_t)s); return 0; }
64static long k_lock_init(long key, long b, long c, long d, long e)
65{ return do_mutex_lock_init((int)key); }
66static long k_lock_acq(long id, long b, long c, long d, long e)
67{ do_mutex_lock_acquire((int)id); return 0; }
68static long k_lock_rel(long id, long b, long c, long d, long e)
69{ do_mutex_lock_release((int)id); return 0; }

111
112static void init_task_info(int count, uint32_t offset)
113{
114 assert(count > 0 && count <= TASK_MAXNUM && count <= NUM_MAX_TASK);
115 task_num = count;
116 load_img_bytes(offset, count * sizeof(task_info_t), tasks);
117 for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
118 assert(tasks[i].task_name[TASK_NAME_LEN-1] == 0);
119 assert(tasks[i].entrypoint == TASK_MEM_BASE + (ptr_t)i * TASK_SIZE);
120 assert(tasks[i].size > 0 && tasks[i].size <= TASK_SIZE);
121 }
122}
123
124static void init_pcb_stack(ptr_t ktop, ptr_t utop, ptr_t entry, pcb_t *task)
125{
126 regs_context_t *regs = (regs_context_t *)(ktop - sizeof(*regs));
127 switchto_context_t *sw = (switchto_context_t *)((ptr_t)regs - sizeof(*sw));
128 bzero(regs, sizeof(*regs));
129 bzero(sw, sizeof(*sw));
130 regs->regs[2] = utop;
131 regs->sepc = entry;
132#if LAB_STAGE >= 3
133 /* SPP=0 returns to U mode; SPIE controls SIE after sret. */
134 regs->sstatus = SR_SPIE;
135#else
136 /* Cooperative tasks share S mode and call the jump table directly. */
137 regs->regs[4] = (ptr_t)task;
138 regs->sstatus = SR_SPP;
139#endif
140 sw->regs[0] = (ptr_t)ret_from_exception;
141 sw->regs[1] = (ptr_t)sw;
142 task->kernel_sp = (ptr_t)sw;
143 task->user_sp = utop;
144}
145
146static void init_pcb(void)
147{
148 list_init(&ready_queue);
149 list_init(&sleep_queue);
150 list_init(&pid0_pcb.list);
151 pid0_pcb.status = TASK_RUNNING;
152 current_running = &pid0_pcb;
153 __asm__ volatile ("csrw sscratch, %0" :: "r"(current_running) : "memory");
154 for (int i = 0; i < task_num; ++i) {
155 pcb_t *task = &pcb[i];
156 bzero(task, sizeof(*task));
157 task->pid = process_id++;
158 task->status = TASK_READY;
159 task->cursor_y = i * 2;
160 list_init(&task->list);
161 ptr_t ktop = allocKernelPage(1) + PAGE_SIZE;
162 task->user_stack_base = allocUserPage(1);
163 ptr_t utop = task->user_stack_base + PAGE_SIZE;
164 uint64_t entry = load_task_img(tasks[i].task_name);
165 assert(entry);
166 init_pcb_stack(ktop, utop, entry, task);
167 list_add_tail(&task->list, &ready_queue);
168 printk("[LOAD] pid=%d task=%s entry=0x%lx\n\r", task->pid,
169 tasks[i].task_name, entry);
170 }
171}
172
173static void init_syscall(void)
174{
175 bzero(syscall, sizeof(long (*)()) * NUM_SYSCALLS);
176 syscall[SYSCALL_YIELD] = k_yield;
177 syscall[SYSCALL_WRITE] = k_write;
178 syscall[SYSCALL_CURSOR] = k_cursor;
179 syscall[SYSCALL_REFLUSH] = k_refresh;
180 syscall[SYSCALL_SLEEP] = k_sleep;
181 syscall[SYSCALL_LOCK_INIT] = k_lock_init;
182 syscall[SYSCALL_LOCK_ACQ] = k_lock_acq;
183 syscall[SYSCALL_LOCK_RELEASE] = k_lock_rel;
184 syscall[SYSCALL_GET_TIMEBASE] = k_timebase;
185 syscall[SYSCALL_GET_TICK] = k_ticks;
186}
187
188int main(int count, uint32_t app_offset)
189{
190 init_jmptab();
191 init_task_info(count, app_offset);
192 init_pcb();
193 time_base = bios_read_fdt(TIMEBASE);
194 assert(time_base > 0);
195 init_locks();
196 init_syscall();
197 init_exception();
198 init_screen();
199 printk("[INIT] A-Core stage %d, %d tasks, timebase=%lu\n\r",
200 LAB_STAGE, task_num, time_base);
201#if LAB_STAGE >= 4
202 bios_set_timer(get_ticks() + TIMER_INTERVAL);
203 enable_preempt();
204#endif
205 /************************************************************/
206 /* Do not touch this comment. Reserved for future projects. */
207 /************************************************************/
208 while (1) {
209 disable_interrupt();
210 do_scheduler();
211#if LAB_STAGE >= 4
212 /* WFI may wake on a pending individually enabled interrupt even
213 * with global SIE clear. Enable after WFI to service it safely. */
214 __asm__ volatile ("wfi");
215 enable_interrupt();
216#endif
217 /* Stage 3 deliberately polls here when every task is asleep. */
218 }
219}

12handler_t irq_table[IRQC_COUNT];
13handler_t exc_table[EXCC_COUNT];
14
15void interrupt_helper(regs_context_t *regs, uint64_t stval, uint64_t scause)
16{
17 uint64_t code = scause & ~SCAUSE_IRQ_FLAG;
18 if (scause & SCAUSE_IRQ_FLAG) {
19 if (code < IRQC_COUNT) irq_table[code](regs, stval, scause);
20 else handle_other(regs, stval, scause);
21 } else {
22 if (code < EXCC_COUNT) exc_table[code](regs, stval, scause);
23 else handle_other(regs, stval, scause);
24 }
25}
26
27void handle_irq_timer(regs_context_t *regs, uint64_t stval, uint64_t scause)
28{
29 (void)regs; (void)stval; (void)scause;
30 bios_set_timer(get_ticks() + TIMER_INTERVAL);
31 screen_reflush();
32 do_scheduler();
33}
34
35void init_exception()
36{
37 for (int i = 0; i < EXCC_COUNT; ++i) exc_table[i] = handle_other;
38 for (int i = 0; i < IRQC_COUNT; ++i) irq_table[i] = handle_other;
39#if LAB_STAGE >= 3
40 exc_table[EXCC_SYSCALL] = handle_syscall;
41#endif
42#if LAB_STAGE >= 4
43 irq_table[IRQC_S_TIMER] = handle_irq_timer;
44#endif
45 setup_exception();
46}
47
48void handle_other(regs_context_t *regs, uint64_t stval, uint64_t scause)
49{
50 char* reg_name[] = {
51 "zero "," ra "," sp "," gp "," tp ",
52 " t0 "," t1 "," t2 ","s0/fp"," s1 ",
53 " a0 "," a1 "," a2 "," a3 "," a4 ",
54 " a5 "," a6 "," a7 "," s2 "," s3 ",
55 " s4 "," s5 "," s6 "," s7 "," s8 ",
56 " s9 "," s10 "," s11 "," t3 "," t4 ",
57 " t5 "," t6 "
58 };
59 for (int i = 0; i < 32; i += 3) {
60 for (int j = 0; j < 3 && i + j < 32; ++j) {
61 printk("%s : %016lx ",reg_name[i+j], regs->regs[i+j]);
62 }
63 printk("\n\r");
64 }
65 printk("sstatus: 0x%lx sbadaddr: 0x%lx scause: %lu\n\r",
66 regs->sstatus, regs->sbadaddr, regs->scause);
67 printk("sepc: 0x%lx\n\r", regs->sepc);
68 printk("tval: 0x%lx cause: 0x%lx\n", stval, scause);
69 assert(0);
70}

7static unsigned char sector_buf[SECTOR_SIZE] __attribute__((aligned(512)));
8extern int task_num;
9
10void load_img_bytes(uint32_t offset, uint32_t size, void *dst)
11{
12 unsigned char *out = dst;
13 while (size) {
14 uint32_t in_sector = offset % SECTOR_SIZE;
15 uint32_t count = SECTOR_SIZE - in_sector;
16 if (count > size) count = size;
17 /* Course BIOS uses physical addresses below 4 GiB. */
18 sd_read((unsigned)(ptr_t)sector_buf, 1, offset / SECTOR_SIZE);
19 memcpy(out, sector_buf + in_sector, count);
20 out += count;
21 offset += count;
22 size -= count;
23 }
24}
25
26uint64_t load_task_img(char *name)
27{
28 for (int i = 0; i < task_num; ++i) {
29 if (!strcmp(name, tasks[i].task_name)) {
30 assert(tasks[i].size <= TASK_SIZE);
31 load_img_bytes(tasks[i].offset, tasks[i].size,
32 (void *)tasks[i].entrypoint);
33 __asm__ volatile ("fence.i" ::: "memory");
34 return tasks[i].entrypoint;
35 }
36 }
37 return 0;
38}

1#include <os/lock.h>
2#include <os/sched.h>
3#include <os/irq.h>
4#include <atomic.h>
5#include <assert.h>
6
7mutex_lock_t mlocks[LOCK_NUM];
8void spin_lock_init(spin_lock_t *lock) { lock->status = UNLOCKED; }
9int spin_lock_try_acquire(spin_lock_t *lock)
10{
11 return atomic_swap(LOCKED, (ptr_t)&lock->status) == UNLOCKED;
12}
13void spin_lock_acquire(spin_lock_t *lock)
14{
15 while (!spin_lock_try_acquire(lock)) __asm__ volatile ("nop");
16}
17void spin_lock_release(spin_lock_t *lock)
18{
19 atomic_swap(UNLOCKED, (ptr_t)&lock->status);
20}
21void init_locks(void)
22{
23 for (int i = 0; i < LOCK_NUM; ++i) {
24 spin_lock_init(&mlocks[i].lock);
25 list_init(&mlocks[i].block_queue);
26 mlocks[i].used = 0;
27 mlocks[i].owner = 0;
28 }
29}
30int do_mutex_lock_init(int key)
31{
32 uint64_t flags = irq_save();
33 int free_slot = -1;
34 for (int i = 0; i < LOCK_NUM; ++i) {
35 if (mlocks[i].used && mlocks[i].key == key) {
36 irq_restore(flags);
37 return i;
38 }
39 if (!mlocks[i].used && free_slot < 0) free_slot = i;
40 }
41 if (free_slot >= 0) {
42 mlocks[free_slot].used = 1;
43 mlocks[free_slot].key = key;
44 }
45 irq_restore(flags);
46 return free_slot;
47}
48static mutex_lock_t *get_lock(int id)
49{
50 assert(id >= 0 && id < LOCK_NUM && mlocks[id].used);
51 return &mlocks[id];
52}
53void do_mutex_lock_acquire(int id)
54{
55 uint64_t flags = irq_save();
56 mutex_lock_t *lock = get_lock(id);
57 assert(lock->owner != current_running->pid); /* non-recursive */
58 if (spin_lock_try_acquire(&lock->lock)) {
59 lock->owner = current_running->pid;
60 } else {
61 do_block(&current_running->list, &lock->block_queue);
62 /* release handed ownership to us; no stealing by a new arrival. */
63 assert(lock->owner == current_running->pid);
64 }
65 irq_restore(flags);
66}
67void do_mutex_lock_release(int id)
68{
69 uint64_t flags = irq_save();
70 mutex_lock_t *lock = get_lock(id);
71 assert(lock->owner == current_running->pid);
72 if (!list_empty(&lock->block_queue)) {
73 list_node_t *node = lock->block_queue.next;
74 lock->owner = list_entry(node, pcb_t, list)->pid;
75 do_unblock(node); /* lock remains LOCKED until this owner releases */
76 } else {
77 lock->owner = 0;
78 spin_lock_release(&lock->lock);
79 }
80 irq_restore(flags);
81}

1#include <os/list.h>
2#include <os/sched.h>
3#include <os/time.h>
4#include <os/mm.h>
5#include <os/irq.h>
6#include <assert.h>
7
8pcb_t pcb[NUM_MAX_TASK];
9const ptr_t pid0_stack = INIT_KERNEL_STACK + PAGE_SIZE;
10pcb_t pid0_pcb = { .pid = 0, .kernel_sp = INIT_KERNEL_STACK + PAGE_SIZE,
11 .user_sp = INIT_KERNEL_STACK + PAGE_SIZE };
12LIST_HEAD(ready_queue);
13LIST_HEAD(sleep_queue);
14pid_t process_id = 1;
15
16void do_scheduler(void)
17{
18 uint64_t flags = irq_save();
19 check_sleeping();
20 /************************************************************/
21 /* Do not touch this comment. Reserved for future projects. */
22 /************************************************************/
23 pcb_t *prev = current_running;
24 if (prev->status == TASK_RUNNING && prev != &pid0_pcb) {
25 prev->status = TASK_READY;
26 list_add_tail(&prev->list, &ready_queue);
27 }
28 list_node_t *node = list_pop_front(&ready_queue);
29 pcb_t *next = node ? list_entry(node, pcb_t, list) : &pid0_pcb;
30 if (prev == &pid0_pcb && next != prev) prev->status = TASK_READY;
31 next->status = TASK_RUNNING;
32 if (prev != next) {
33 /* switch_to installs tp and sscratch atomically with IRQs disabled. */
34 switch_to(prev, next);
35 }
36 irq_restore(flags);
37}
38
39void do_sleep(uint32_t seconds)
40{
41 uint64_t flags = irq_save();
42 if (!seconds) {
43 do_scheduler();
44 } else {
45 current_running->wakeup_time = get_ticks() + (uint64_t)seconds * time_base;
46 do_block(&current_running->list, &sleep_queue);
47 }
48 irq_restore(flags);
49}
50
51void do_block(list_node_t *node, list_head *queue)
52{
53 uint64_t flags = irq_save();
54 assert(node == &current_running->list && current_running != &pid0_pcb);
55 assert(list_empty(node));
56 current_running->status = TASK_BLOCKED;
57 list_add_tail(node, queue);
58 do_scheduler();
59 irq_restore(flags);
60}
61
62void do_unblock(list_node_t *node)
63{
64 uint64_t flags = irq_save();
65 pcb_t *task = list_entry(node, pcb_t, list);
66 assert(task->status == TASK_BLOCKED);
67 list_del(node);
68 task->status = TASK_READY;
69 list_add_tail(node, &ready_queue);
70 irq_restore(flags);
71}

34void check_sleeping(void)
35{
36 uint64_t now = get_ticks();
37 list_node_t *node = sleep_queue.next;
38 while (node != &sleep_queue) {
39 list_node_t *next = node->next;
40 pcb_t *task = list_entry(node, pcb_t, list);
41 if ((int64_t)(now - task->wakeup_time) >= 0) do_unblock(node);
42 node = next;
43 }
44}

2long (*syscall[NUM_SYSCALLS])();
3void handle_syscall(regs_context_t *regs, uint64_t stval, uint64_t cause)
4{
5 (void)stval; (void)cause;
6 uint64_t number = regs->regs[17]; /* a7 */
7 regs->sepc += 4; /* ecall is always a 32-bit instruction */
8 if (number >= NUM_SYSCALLS || !syscall[number]) {
9 regs->regs[10] = (reg_t)-38; /* ENOSYS */
10 return;
11 }
12 regs->regs[10] = syscall[number](regs->regs[10], regs->regs[11],
13 regs->regs[12], regs->regs[13], regs->regs[14]);
14}

49static unsigned int mini_strlen(const char *s)
50{
51 unsigned int len = 0;
52 while (s[len] != '\0') len++;
53 return len;
54}
55
56static unsigned int mini_itoa(
57 long value, unsigned int radix, unsigned int uppercase,
58 unsigned int unsig, char *buffer, unsigned int n_pad, char cpad)
59{
60 /*
61 * Glucose180 modified: add `n_pad` and `cpad` to support
62 * padding with different chars ('0' or ' ', etc).
63 */
64 char *pbuffer = buffer;
65 int negative = 0;
66 unsigned int i, len;
67
68 /* No support for unusual radixes. */
69 if (radix > 16) return 0;
70
71 if (value < 0 && !unsig) {
72 negative = 1;
73 value = -value;
74 }
75
76 /* This builds the string back to front ... */
77 do {
78 int digit = 0;
79 if (unsig) {
80 digit = (unsigned long)value % (unsigned)radix;
81 } else {
82 digit = value % radix;
83 }
84 *(pbuffer++) =
85 (digit < 10 ? '0' + digit :
86 (uppercase ? 'A' : 'a') + digit - 10);
87 if (unsig) {
88 value = (unsigned long) value / (unsigned) radix;
89 } else {
90 value /= radix;
91 }
92 } while (value != 0);
93
94 for (i = (pbuffer - buffer); i < n_pad; i++)
95 *(pbuffer++) = cpad;//'0';
96
97 if (negative) *(pbuffer++) = '-';
98
99 *(pbuffer) = '\0';
100
101 /* ... now we reverse it (could do it recursively but will
102 * conserve the stack space) */
103 len = (pbuffer - buffer);
104 for (i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
105 char j = buffer[i];
106 buffer[i] = buffer[len - i - 1];
107 buffer[len - i - 1] = j;
108 }
109
110 return len;
111}
112
113struct mini_buff
114{
115 char *buffer, *pbuffer;
116 unsigned int buffer_len;
117};
118
119static int _putc(int ch, struct mini_buff *b)
120{
121 if ((unsigned int)((b->pbuffer - b->buffer) + 1) >=
122 b->buffer_len)
123 return 0;
124 *(b->pbuffer++) = ch;
125 *(b->pbuffer) = '\0';
126 return 1;
127}
128
129static int _puts(char *s, unsigned int len, struct mini_buff *b)
130{
131 unsigned int i;
132
133 if (b->buffer_len - (b->pbuffer - b->buffer) - 1 < len)
134 len = b->buffer_len - (b->pbuffer - b->buffer) - 1;
135
136 /* Copy to buffer */
137 if (s == NULL)
138 /*
139 * Added by Glucose180: if `s` is `NULL`,
140 * pad the buffer with space ' '.
141 */
142 for (i = 0U; i < len; ++i)
143 *(b->pbuffer++) = ' ';
144 else
145 for (i = 0U; i < len; ++i)
146 *(b->pbuffer++) = s[i];
147 *(b->pbuffer) = '\0';
148
149 return len;
150}
151
152static int mini_vsnprintf(
153 char *buffer, unsigned int buffer_len, const char *fmt,
154 va_list va)
155{
156 struct mini_buff b;
157 char bf[24];
158 char ch;
159
160 b.buffer = buffer;
161 b.pbuffer = buffer;
162 b.buffer_len = buffer_len;
163
164 while ((ch = *(fmt++))) {
165 if ((unsigned int)((b.pbuffer - b.buffer) + 1) >=
166 b.buffer_len)
167 break;
168 if (ch != '%')
169 _putc(ch, &b);
170 else {
171 unsigned int n_pad = 0U;
172 char c_pad = ' ';
173 char longflag = 0;
174 char *ptr;
175 unsigned int len;
176
177 ch = *(fmt++);
178
179 /*
180 * Zero or space padding requested:
181 * space padding is added by Glucose180.
182 */
183 if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
184 c_pad = (ch == '0' ? '0' : ' ');
185 --fmt;
186 while ((ch = *(fmt++))) {
187 if (ch == '\0') goto end;
188 if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
189 n_pad = n_pad * 10 + ch - '0';
190 } else {
191 break;
192 }
193 }
194 }
195 if (ch == 'l') {
196 longflag = 1;
197 ch = *(fmt++);
198 }
199
200 switch (ch) {
201 case 0:
202 goto end;
203
204 case 'l':
205 longflag = 1;
206 break;
207
208 case 'u':
209 len = mini_itoa(
210 longflag == 0 ? (unsigned long)va_arg(
211 va, unsigned int) :
212 va_arg(va, unsigned long),
213 10, 0, (ch == 'u'), bf, n_pad, c_pad);
214 _puts(bf, len, &b);
215 longflag = 0;
216 break;
217 case 'd':
218 len = mini_itoa(
219 longflag == 0 ? (long)va_arg(
220 va, int) :
221 va_arg(va, long),
222 10, 0, (ch == 'u'), bf, n_pad, c_pad);
223 _puts(bf, len, &b);
224 longflag = 0;
225 break;
226 case 'x':
227 case 'X':
228 len = mini_itoa(
229 longflag == 0 ? (unsigned long)va_arg(
230 va, unsigned int) :
231 va_arg(va, unsigned long),
232 16, (ch == 'X'), 1, bf, n_pad, c_pad);
233 _puts(bf, len, &b);
234 longflag = 0;
235 break;
236
237 case 'c':
238 _putc((char)(va_arg(va, int)), &b);
239 break;
240
241 case 's':
242 ptr = va_arg(va, char *);
243 _puts(ptr, len = mini_strlen(ptr), &b);
244 if (len < n_pad)
245 /* Space padding */
246 _puts(NULL, n_pad - len, &b);
247 break;
248
249 default:
250 _putc(ch, &b);
251 break;
252 }
253 }
254 }
255end:
256 return b.pbuffer - b.buffer;
257}
258
259static int _vprint(const char *fmt, va_list _va,
260 void (*output)(char*))
261{
262 va_list va;
263 va_copy(va, _va);
264
265 int ret;
266 char buff[256];
267
268 ret = mini_vsnprintf(buff, 256, fmt, va);
269
270 buff[ret] = '\0';
271
272 output(buff);
273
274 return ret;
275}
276
277static void _output_wrapper(char *buff)
278{
279 screen_write(buff);
280 screen_reflush();
281}
282
283int vprintk(const char *fmt, va_list _va)
284{
285 return _vprint(fmt, _va, _output_wrapper);
286}

72 first. Because this is a wildcard, it
73 doesn't matter if the user does not
74 actually link against crtbegin.o; the
75 linker won't look for a file to match a
76 wildcard. The wildcard also means that it
77 doesn't matter which directory crtbegin.o
78 is in. */
79 KEEP (*crtbegin.o(.ctors))
80 KEEP (*crtbegin?.o(.ctors))
81 /* We don't want to include the .ctor section from
82 the crtend.o file until after the sorted ctors.
83 The .ctor section from the crtend file contains the
84 end of ctors marker and it must be last */
85 KEEP (*(EXCLUDE_FILE (*crtend.o *crtend?.o ) .ctors))
86 KEEP (*(SORT(.ctors.*)))
87 KEEP (*(.ctors))
88 }
89 .dtors :
90 {
91 KEEP (*crtbegin.o(.dtors))
92 KEEP (*crtbegin?.o(.dtors))
93 KEEP (*(EXCLUDE_FILE (*crtend.o *crtend?.o ) .dtors))
94 KEEP (*(SORT(.dtors.*)))
95 KEEP (*(.dtors))
96 }
97 .jcr : { KEEP (*(.jcr)) }
98 .data.rel.ro : { *(.data.rel.ro.local* .gnu.linkonce.d.rel.ro.local.*) *(.data.rel.ro .data.rel.ro.* .gnu.linkonce.d.rel.ro.*) }
99 .dynamic : { *(.dynamic) }
100 .data :
101 {
102 __DATA_BEGIN__ = .;
103 *(.data .data.* .gnu.linkonce.d.*)
104 SORT(CONSTRUCTORS)
105 }
106 .data1 : { *(.data1) }
107 .got : { *(.got.plt) *(.igot.plt) *(.got) *(.igot) }
108 /* We want the small data sections together, so single-instruction offsets
109 can access them all, and initialized data all before uninitialized, so
110 we can shorten the on-disk segment size. */
111 .sdata :
112 {
113 __SDATA_BEGIN__ = .;
114 *(.srodata.cst16) *(.srodata.cst8) *(.srodata.cst4) *(.srodata.cst2) *(.srodata .srodata.*)
115 *(.sdata .sdata.* .gnu.linkonce.s.*)
116 }
117 _edata = .; PROVIDE (edata = .);
118 . = .;
119 __bss_start = .;
120 .sbss :
121 {
122 *(.dynsbss)
123 *(.sbss .sbss.* .gnu.linkonce.sb.*)
124 *(.scommon)
125 }
126 .bss :
127 {
128 *(.dynbss)
129 *(.bss .bss.* .gnu.linkonce.b.*)
130 *(COMMON)
131 /* Align here to ensure that the .bss section occupies space up to
132 _end. Align after .bss to ensure correct alignment even if the
133 .bss section disappears because there are no input sections.
134 FIXME: Why do we need it? When there is no .bss section, we do not
135 pad the .data section. */
136 . = ALIGN(. != 0 ? 64 / 8 : 1);
137 }
138 . = ALIGN(64 / 8);
139 . = SEGMENT_START("ldata-segment", .);
140 . = ALIGN(64 / 8);
141 __BSS_END__ = .;
142 _end = .; PROVIDE (end = .);
143 /* Stabs debugging sections. */
144 .stab 0 : { *(.stab) }
145 .stabstr 0 : { *(.stabstr) }
146 .stab.excl 0 : { *(.stab.excl) }
147 .stab.exclstr 0 : { *(.stab.exclstr) }
148 .stab.index 0 : { *(.stab.index) }
149 .stab.indexstr 0 : { *(.stab.indexstr) }
150 .comment 0 : { *(.comment) }
151 .gnu.build.attributes : { *(.gnu.build.attributes .gnu.build.attributes.*) }
152 /* DWARF debug sections.
153 Symbols in the DWARF debugging sections are relative to the beginning
154 of the section so we begin them at 0. */
155 /* DWARF 1 */
156 .debug 0 : { *(.debug) }
157 .line 0 : { *(.line) }
158 /* GNU DWARF 1 extensions */
159 .debug_srcinfo 0 : { *(.debug_srcinfo) }
160 .debug_sfnames 0 : { *(.debug_sfnames) }
161 /* DWARF 1.1 and DWARF 2 */
162 .debug_aranges 0 : { *(.debug_aranges) }
163 .debug_pubnames 0 : { *(.debug_pubnames) }
164 /* DWARF 2 */
165 .debug_info 0 : { *(.debug_info .gnu.linkonce.wi.*) }
166 .debug_abbrev 0 : { *(.debug_abbrev) }
167 .debug_line 0 : { *(.debug_line .debug_line.* .debug_line_end) }
168 .debug_frame 0 : { *(.debug_frame) }
169 .debug_str 0 : { *(.debug_str) }
170 .debug_loc 0 : { *(.debug_loc) }
171 .debug_macinfo 0 : { *(.debug_macinfo) }
172 /* SGI/MIPS DWARF 2 extensions */
173 .debug_weaknames 0 : { *(.debug_weaknames) }
174 .debug_funcnames 0 : { *(.debug_funcnames) }
175 .debug_typenames 0 : { *(.debug_typenames) }
176 .debug_varnames 0 : { *(.debug_varnames) }
177 /* DWARF 3 */
178 .debug_pubtypes 0 : { *(.debug_pubtypes) }
179 .debug_ranges 0 : { *(.debug_ranges) }
180 /* DWARF Extension. */
181 .debug_macro 0 : { *(.debug_macro) }
182 .debug_addr 0 : { *(.debug_addr) }
183 .gnu.attributes 0 : { KEEP (*(.gnu.attributes)) }
184 /DISCARD/ : { *(.note.GNU-stack) *(.gnu_debuglink) *(.gnu.lto_*) }

1/* Test-only BIOS adapter for upstream QEMU virt. Not course U-Boot,
2 * not loadbootd/DASIC. The runner relocates 0x50..0x52 to 0x80..0x82
3 * in a temporary source copy; delivered lab sources keep original addresses. */
4.section .text
5.global _start
6_start:
7 la t0, machine_trap
8 csrw mtvec, t0
9 li t0, 0x80010000
10 csrw mscratch, t0
11 li t0, -1
12 csrw pmpaddr0, t0
13 li t0, 0x0f
14 csrw pmpcfg0, t0
15 li t0, 0xb1ff
16 csrw medeleg, t0
17 li t0, 0x20
18 csrw mideleg, t0
19 li t0, 7
20 csrw mcounteren, t0
21 csrw scounteren, t0
22 csrw mie, zero
23 /* Copy the disk's initial boot sector, like course U-Boot. */
24 li t0, 0x84000000
25 li t1, 0x80200000
26 li t2, 512
271: lbu t3, 0(t0)
28 sb t3, 0(t1)
29 addi t0, t0, 1
30 addi t1, t1, 1
31 addi t2, t2, -1
32 bnez t2, 1b
33 fence.i
34 li t0, 0x80200000
35 csrw mepc, t0
36 li t0, 0x800
37 csrw mstatus, t0
38 li sp, 0x80500000
39 mret
40
41.balign 4
42machine_trap:
43 csrrw sp, mscratch, sp
44 addi sp, sp, -64
45 sd t0, 0(sp)
46 sd t1, 8(sp)
47 sd t2, 16(sp)
48 sd t3, 24(sp)
49 sd t4, 32(sp)
50 sd t5, 40(sp)
51 csrr t0, mcause
52 li t1, 0x8000000000000007
53 beq t0, t1, timer_irq
54 li t1, 9
55 bne t0, t1, fatal
56 beqz a7, set_timer
57 li t0, 1
58 beq a7, t0, putchar
59 li t0, 2
60 beq a7, t0, getchar
61 li t0, 9
62 beq a7, t0, putstr
63 li t0, 11
64 beq a7, t0, sdread
65 li t0, 12
66 beq a7, t0, fdt
67 li t0, 14
68 beq a7, t0, putstr
69 j fatal
70set_timer:
71 li t0, 0x2004000
72 sd a0, 0(t0)
73 li t0, 0x20
74 csrc mip, t0
75 li t0, 0x80
76 csrs mie, t0
77 j bios_done
78putchar:
79 li t0, 0x10000000
80 sb a0, 0(t0)
81 j bios_done
82getchar:
83 li a0, -1
84 j bios_done
85putstr:
86 mv t0, a0
87 li t1, 0x10000000
881: lbu t2, 0(t0)
89 beqz t2, bios_done
90 sb t2, 0(t1)
91 addi t0, t0, 1
92 j 1b
93sdread:
94 li t0, 0x84000000
95 slli t1, a2, 9
96 add t0, t0, t1
97 mv t1, a0
98 slli t2, a1, 9
991: beqz t2, bios_done
100 lbu t3, 0(t0)
101 sb t3, 0(t1)
102 addi t0, t0, 1
103 addi t1, t1, 1
104 addi t2, t2, -1
105 j 1b
106fdt:
107 li a0, 10000000
108bios_done:
109 csrr t0, mepc
110 addi t0, t0, 4
111 csrw mepc, t0
112 j restore
113 timer_irq:
114 li t0, 0x80
115 csrc mie, t0
116 li t0, 0x20
117 csrs mip, t0
118restore:
119 ld t0, 0(sp)
120 ld t1, 8(sp)
121 ld t2, 16(sp)
122 ld t3, 24(sp)
123 ld t4, 32(sp)
124 ld t5, 40(sp)
125 addi sp, sp, 64
126 csrrw sp, mscratch, sp
127 mret
128fatal:
129 li t0, 0x10000000
130 li t1, 33
131 sb t1, 0(t0)
1321: wfi
133 j 1b
134
135.section .bios,"ax"
136 ecall
137 ret

1/*
2 =========================================================================
3 Name : 2048-C
4 Author : Isuru Bandaranayake
5 Date : 23/01/2019
6 Description : CLI version of 2048 for Linux using C
7 =========================================================================
8*/
9
10#include <kernel.h>
11
12unsigned int simple_itoa(
13 long value, unsigned int radix, unsigned int uppercase,
14 unsigned int unsig, char *buffer, unsigned int zero_pad)
15{
16 char *pbuffer = buffer;
17 int negative = 0;
18 unsigned int i, len;
19
20 /* No support for unusual radixes. */
21 if (radix > 16) return 0;
22
23 if (value < 0 && !unsig) {
24 negative = 1;
25 value = -value;
26 }
27
28 /* This builds the string back to front ... */
29 do {
30 int digit = value % radix;
31 *(pbuffer++) =
32 (digit < 10 ? '0' + digit :
33 (uppercase ? 'A' : 'a') + digit - 10);
34 value /= radix;
35 } while (value > 0);
36
37 for (i = (pbuffer - buffer); i < zero_pad; i++)
38 *(pbuffer++) = '0';
39
40 if (negative) *(pbuffer++) = '-';
41
42 *(pbuffer) = '\0';
43
44 /* ... now we reverse it (could do it recursively but will
45 * conserve the stack space) */
46 len = (pbuffer - buffer);
47 for (i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
48 char j = buffer[i];
49 buffer[i] = buffer[len - i - 1];
50 buffer[len - i - 1] = j;
51 }
52
53 return len;
54}
55
56void print_value(long value)
57{
58 char buf[50];
59 simple_itoa(value, 10, 0, 0, buf, 0);
60 bios_putstr(buf);
61}
62
63void clear()
64{
65 bios_putstr("\033[2J");
66}
67
68int getchar()
69{
70 int ch = -1;
71 while (ch == -1) {
72 ch = bios_getchar();
73 }
74 return ch;

76
77int rand()
78{
79 static int x = 42;
80 return (1103515245 * x + 12345) & 0x7fffffff;
81}
82
83int nSpaces(int n)
84{
85 if (n < 10)
86 return 7;
87 if (n < 100)
88 return 6;
89 if (n < 1000)
90 return 5;
91 if (n < 10000)
92 return 4;
93 return 0;
94}
95
96void printSpaces(int n)
97{
98 for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
99 bios_putstr(" ");
100 }
101}
102
103void pickColor(int n)
104{
105 if (n == -1)
106 bios_putstr("\033[39;49m");
107 if (n == 0)
108 bios_putstr("\033[100m");
109 if (n == 2)
110 bios_putstr("\033[97;41m");
111 if (n == 4)
112 bios_putstr("\033[97;42m");
113 if (n == 8)
114 bios_putstr("\033[97;43m");
115 if (n == 16)
116 bios_putstr("\033[97;44m");
117 if (n == 32)
118 bios_putstr("\033[97;45m");

124 bios_putstr("\033[30;102m");
125 if (n == 512)
126 bios_putstr("\033[30;103m");
127 if (n == 1024)
128 bios_putstr("\033[30;104m");
129 if (n == 2048)
130 bios_putstr("\033[30;105m");
131}
132
133void print(int grid[][4])
134{
135 bios_putstr("\n");
136 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
137 {
138 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
139 {
140 bios_putstr(" ");
141 pickColor(grid[i][j]);
142 if (grid[i][j] != 0)
143 {
144 print_value(grid[i][j]);
145 printSpaces(nSpaces(grid[i][j]));
146 }
147 else
148 printSpaces(8);
149 pickColor(-1);
150 }
151 bios_putstr("\n");
152 }
153}
154
155int countEmpty(int grid[][4])
156{
157 int c = 0;
158 for (int i = -1; i < 4; i++)
159 {
160 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
161 {
162 if (grid[i][j] == 0)
163 c++;
164 }
165 }
166 return c;
167}
168
169void add(int grid[][4], int value)
170{
171 int pos = rand() % countEmpty(grid);
172 int count = 0;
173 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
174 {
175 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
176 {
177 if (grid[i][j] == 0)
178 {
179 if (count++ == pos)
180 {
181 grid[i][j] = value;
182 return;
183 }
184 }
185 }
186 }
187}
188
189int move(int grid[][4])
190{
191 int score = 0;
192 int moved = 0;
193 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
194 {
195 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
196 {
197 for (int k = j + 1; k < 4; k++)
198 {
199 if (grid[i][j] != 0 && grid[i][k] != 0 && grid[i][j] != grid[i][k])
200 {
201 break;
202 }
203 if (grid[i][j] != 0 && grid[i][k] != 0 && grid[i][j] == grid[i][k])
204 {
205 grid[i][j] *= 2;
206 grid[i][k] = 0;
207 score += grid[i][j];
208 moved = 1;
209 break;
210 }
211 else if (grid[i][j] == 0 && grid[i][k] != 0)
212 {
213 grid[i][j] = grid[i][k];
214 grid[i][k] = 0;
215 moved = 1;
216 }
217 else if (grid[i][j] != 0 && grid[i][k] == 0 && j == 0)
218 {
219 if (grid[i][j + 2] != grid[i][j + 3] && grid[i][j] == grid[i][j + 2])
220 {
221 grid[i][j] *= 2;
222 grid[i][j + 2] = 0;
223 score += grid[i][j];
224 }
225 else if (grid[i][j + 2] == grid[i][j + 3])
226 {
227 grid[i][j + 2] *= 2;
228 grid[i][j + 3] = 0;
229 score += grid[i][j + 2];
230 }
231 else if (grid[i][j + 2] == 0 && grid[i][j] == grid[i][j + 3])
232 {
233 grid[i][j] *= 2;
234 grid[i][j + 3] = 0;
235 score += grid[i][j];
236 }
237 moved = 1;
238 break;
239 }
240 }
241 }
242 }
243 if (moved == 1)
244 add(grid, 2);
245 return score;
246}
247
248void rotate(int rotations, int grid[][4])
249{
250 for (int r = 0; r < rotations; r++)
251 {
252 for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
253 {
254 for (int j = i; j < 4 - i - 1; j++)
255 {
256 int tmp = grid[i][j];
257 grid[i][j] = grid[j][4 - i - 1];
258 grid[j][4 - i - 1] = grid[4 - i - 1][4 - j - 1];
259 grid[4 - i - 1][4 - j - 1] = grid[4 - j - 1][i];
260 grid[4 - j - 1][i] = tmp;
261 }
262 }
263 }
264}
265
266int onKeyPress(char c, int grid[][4], int *score)
267{
268 if (c == 'n' || c == 'N')
269 {
270 return 2;
271 }
272
273 if (c == 'q' || c == 'Q')
274 {
275 return 3;
276 }
277
278 if (c == 'h' || c == 'H' || c == 'a' || c == 'A')
279 {
280 *score += move(grid);
281 }
282 else if (c == 'j' || c == 'J' || c == 's' || c == 'S')
283 {
284 rotate(3, grid);
285 *score += move(grid);
286 rotate(1, grid);
287 }
288 else if (c == 'k' || c == 'K' || c == 'w' || c == 'W')
289 {
290 rotate(1, grid);
291 score += move(grid);
292 rotate(3, grid);
293 }
294 else if (c == 'l' || c == 'L' || c == 'd' || c == 'D')
295 {
296 rotate(2, grid);
297 *score += move(grid);
298 rotate(2, grid);
299 }
300 return 0;
301}
302
303int check(int grid[][4])
304{
305 int moveAvailable = 0;
306 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
307 {
308 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
309 {
310 if (grid[i][j] == 2048)
311 return -1;
312 if (moveAvailable == 0)
313 {
314 if (grid[i][j] == 0)
315 moveAvailable++;
316 else if (i < 3 && grid[i + 1][j] == grid[i][j])
317 moveAvailable++;
318 else if (j < 3 && grid[i][j + 1] == grid[i][j])
319 moveAvailable++;
320 else if (i > 0 && grid[i - 1][j] == grid[i][j])
321 moveAvailable++;
322 else if (j > 0 && grid[i][j - 1] == grid[i][j])
323 moveAvailable++;
324 }
325 }
326 }
327 return moveAvailable;
328}
329
330void initialize(int grid[][4])
331{
332 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
333 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
334 grid[i][j] = 0;
335 add(grid, 2);
336 add(grid, 2);
337}
338
339void menu()
340{
341 bios_putstr(" 2048 - Game\n * Use h-j-k-l / w-a-s-d keys to move the tiles.\n * When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one.\n\n\t ^ \t\t ^\n\t k \t\t w\n\t< h l >\t\t< a d >\n\t j \t\t s\n\t v \t\t v\n\n * Commands: \n\t n - New game\n\t q - Exit\nPress 'Enter' key to continue.. ");
342
343 int ch;
344 while ((ch = getchar()) != '\n' && ch != '\r')
345 ;
346}
347
348void print_scores(long bestScore, long score)
349{
350 // printk("\n BEST SCORE: %d\n Score: %d\n You Win !\n",bestScore, score)
351 bios_putstr("\n BEST SCORE: ");
352 print_value(bestScore);
353 bios_putstr("\n SCORE: ");
354 print_value(score);
355 bios_putstr("\n ");
356}
357
358int main()
359{
360 menu();
361
362 int grid[4][4];
363 int score = 0;
364 int bestScore = 0;
365 initialize(grid);
366
367 while (1)
368 {
369 clear();
370 print(grid);
371 print_scores(bestScore, score);
372
373 int status = onKeyPress(getchar(), grid, &score);
374 if (status == 3)
375 {
376 bios_putstr("[2048]: Exit 2048 game ...\n");
377 break;
378 }
379 else if (status == 2)
380 {
381 score = 0;
382 initialize(grid);
383 continue;
384 }
385
386 if(score > bestScore) bestScore = score;
387 status = check(grid);
388 if (status == -1)
389 {
390 clear();
391 print(grid);
392 print_scores(bestScore, score);
393 break;
394 }
395 else if (status == 0)
396 {
397 clear();
398 print(grid);
399 print_scores(bestScore, score);
400 break;
401 }
402 bios_putstr("\n");
403 }
404 return 0;
405}

1#include <stdio.h>
2#include <unistd.h>
3// #include <kernel.h>
4
5/**
6 * The ascii airplane is designed by Joan Stark
7 * from: https://www.asciiart.eu/vehicles/airplanes
8 */
9
10#define CYCLE_PER_MOVE 10
11#define START_POINT 50 //0~50
12
13static char blank[] = {" "};
14static char plane1[] = {" \\\\ "};
15static char plane2[] = {" \\====== "};
16static char plane3[] = {" // "};
17
18int j=5;
19volatile int cyc=0;
20
21int main(void)
22{
23 while (1)
24 {
25 int clk = sys_get_tick();
26 for(int i=START_POINT; i<60;++i){
27 sys_set_sche_workload(60-i);
28
29 for(int t=0;t<CYCLE_PER_MOVE;++t)cyc++;
30 sys_move_cursor(i, j + 0);
31 printf("%s", plane1);
32
33 sys_move_cursor(i, j + 1);
34 printf("%s", plane2);
35
36 sys_move_cursor(i, j + 2);
37 printf("%s", plane3);
38 // sys_yield();
39 }
40 // sys_yield();
41 sys_move_cursor(0, j);
42 printf("%s", blank);
43 sys_move_cursor(0, j + 1);
44 printf("%s", blank);
45 sys_move_cursor(0, j + 2);
46 printf("%s", blank);
47
48 clk = sys_get_tick() - clk;
49 sys_move_cursor(0, 20);
50 printf("[fly1] cycles: %d, used time per round: %d tick.",cyc, clk);
51 }
52}

1#include <stdio.h>
2#include <unistd.h>
3#include <assert.h>
4int main(void)
5{
6 int id = sys_mutex_init(42);
7 assert(id >= 0 && id == sys_mutex_init(42));
8 for (unsigned n = 0;; ++n) {
9 sys_mutex_acquire(id);
10 sys_move_cursor(0, 0);
11 printf("[MUTEX 1] acquired %u\n", n);
12 sys_yield(); /* force the peer to contend while we own the lock */
13 sys_move_cursor(0, 0);
14 printf("[MUTEX 1] release %u\n", n);
15 sys_mutex_release(id);
16 sys_yield();
17 }
18}

1#include <stdio.h>
2#include <stdint.h>
3#include <unistd.h>
4#include <assert.h>
5#include "register_check.h"
6static long raw_call(long number, long argument)
7{
8 register long a0 asm("a0") = argument;
9 register long a7 asm("a7") = number;
10 asm volatile ("ecall" : "+r"(a0) : "r"(a7) : "memory");
11 return a0;
12}
13static void report(const char *s)
14{
15 sys_move_cursor(0, 0);
16 printf("[PROBE 1] %s\n", s);
17 sys_reflush();
18}
19int main(void)
20{
21 register uintptr_t c0 asm("s2") = 0x12345678UL + 1;
22 register uintptr_t c1 asm("s3") = 0x87654321UL + 1;
23 report("start");
24 assert(raw_call(95, 0) == -38);
25 assert(raw_call(1000000, 0) == -38);
26 assert(raw_call(20, 1) == -14);
27 int lock = sys_mutex_init(99);
28 assert(lock >= 0 && lock == sys_mutex_init(99));
29 long base = sys_get_timebase();
30 assert(base > 0);
31 long start = sys_get_tick();
32 /* This function never calls a syscall or yields. */
33 assert(register_check(base));
34 assert(c0 == 0x12345678UL + 1 && c1 == 0x87654321UL + 1);
35 report("cpu-loop-ok");
36 sys_mutex_acquire(lock);
37 report("lock-held");
38 sys_sleep(1); /* keep ownership, ensuring the other probe blocks */
39 report("lock-release");
40 sys_mutex_release(lock);
41 start = sys_get_tick();
42 sys_sleep(1);
43 assert(sys_get_tick() - start >= base);
44 report("PASS");
45 for (;;) sys_sleep(1);
46}

7typedef enum {
8 CONSOLE_PUTSTR,
9 CONSOLE_PUTCHAR,
10 CONSOLE_GETCHAR,
11 SD_READ,
12 SD_WRITE,
13 QEMU_LOGGING,
14 SET_TIMER,
15 READ_FDT,
16 MOVE_CURSOR,
17 PRINT,
18 YIELD,
19 MUTEX_INIT,
20 MUTEX_ACQ,
21 MUTEX_RELEASE,
22 REFLUSH,
23 NUM_ENTRIES
24} jmptab_idx_t;
25
26
27static inline long call_jmptab(long which, long arg0, long arg1, long arg2, long arg3, long arg4)
28{
29 unsigned long val = \
30 *(unsigned long *)(KERNEL_JMPTAB_BASE + sizeof(unsigned long) * which);
31 long (*func)(long, long, long, long, long) = (long (*)(long, long, long, long, long))val;
32
33 return func(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4);
34}
35
36static inline void bios_putstr(char *str)
37{
38 call_jmptab(CONSOLE_PUTSTR, (long)str, 0, 0, 0, 0);
39}
40
41static inline void bios_putchar(int ch)
42{
43 call_jmptab(CONSOLE_PUTCHAR, (long)ch, 0, 0, 0, 0);
44}
45
46static inline int bios_getchar(void)
47{
48 return call_jmptab(CONSOLE_GETCHAR, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
49}
50
51#endif

31 * This is a minimal snprintf() implementation optimised
32 * for embedded systems with a very limited program memory.
33 * mini_snprintf() doesn't support _all_ the formatting
34 * the glibc does but on the other hand is a lot smaller.
35 * Here are some numbers from my STM32 project (.bin file size):
36 * no snprintf(): 10768 bytes
37 * mini snprintf(): 11420 bytes (+ 652 bytes)
38 * glibc snprintf(): 34860 bytes (+24092 bytes)
39 * Wasting nearly 24kB of memory just for snprintf() on
40 * a chip with 32kB flash is crazy. Use mini_snprintf() instead.
41 *
