44#include <stdarg.h>
45#include <string.h>
46#include <unistd.h>
47
48static unsigned int mini_itoa(
49 long value, unsigned int radix, unsigned int uppercase,
50 unsigned int unsig, char *buffer, unsigned int zero_pad)
51{
52 char *pbuffer = buffer;
53 int negative = 0;
54 unsigned int i, len;
55
56 /* No support for unusual radixes. */
57 if (radix > 16) return 0;
58
59 if (value < 0 && !unsig) {
60 negative = 1;
61 value = -value;
62 }
63
64 /* This builds the string back to front ... */
65 do {
66 int digit = value % radix;
67 *(pbuffer++) =
68 (digit < 10 ? '0' + digit :
69 (uppercase ? 'A' : 'a') + digit - 10);
70 value /= radix;
71 } while (value > 0);
72
73 for (i = (pbuffer - buffer); i < zero_pad; i++)
74 *(pbuffer++) = '0';
75
76 if (negative) *(pbuffer++) = '-';
77
78 *(pbuffer) = '\0';
79
80 /* ... now we reverse it (could do it recursively but will
81 * conserve the stack space) */
82 len = (pbuffer - buffer);
83 for (i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
84 char j = buffer[i];
85 buffer[i] = buffer[len - i - 1];
86 buffer[len - i - 1] = j;
87 }
88
89 return len;
90}
91
92struct mini_buff
93{
94 char *buffer, *pbuffer;
95 unsigned int buffer_len;
96};
97
98static int _putc(int ch, struct mini_buff *b)
99{
100 if ((unsigned int)((b->pbuffer - b->buffer) + 1) >=
101 b->buffer_len)
102 return 0;
103 *(b->pbuffer++) = ch;
104 *(b->pbuffer) = '\0';
105 return 1;
106}
107
108static int _puts(char *s, unsigned int len, struct mini_buff *b)
109{
110 unsigned int i;
111
112 if (b->buffer_len - (b->pbuffer - b->buffer) - 1 < len)
113 len = b->buffer_len - (b->pbuffer - b->buffer) - 1;
114
115 /* Copy to buffer */
116 for (i = 0; i < len; i++) *(b->pbuffer++) = s[i];
117 *(b->pbuffer) = '\0';
118
119 return len;
120}
121
122static int mini_vsnprintf(
123 char *buffer, unsigned int buffer_len, const char *fmt,
124 va_list va)
125{
126 struct mini_buff b;
127 char bf[24];
128 char ch;
129
130 b.buffer = buffer;
131 b.pbuffer = buffer;
132 b.buffer_len = buffer_len;
133
134 while ((ch = *(fmt++))) {
135 if ((unsigned int)((b.pbuffer - b.buffer) + 1) >=
136 b.buffer_len)
137 break;
138 if (ch != '%')
139 _putc(ch, &b);
140 else {
141 char zero_pad = 0;
142 int longflag = 0;
143 char *ptr;
144 unsigned int len;
145
146 ch = *(fmt++);
147
148 /* Zero padding requested */
149 if (ch == '0') {
150 while ((ch = *(fmt++))) {
151 if (ch == '\0') goto end;
152 if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
153 zero_pad = zero_pad * 10 + ch - '0';
154 } else {
155 break;
156 }
157 }
158 }
159 if (ch == 'l') {
160 longflag = 1;
161 ch = *(fmt++);
162 }
163
164 switch (ch) {
165 case 0:
166 goto end;
167
168 case 'l':
169 longflag = 1;
170 break;
171
172 case 'u':
173 len = mini_itoa(
174 longflag == 0 ? (unsigned long)va_arg(
175 va, unsigned int) :
176 va_arg(va, unsigned long),
177 10, 0, (ch == 'u'), bf, zero_pad);
178 _puts(bf, len, &b);
179 longflag = 0;
180 break;
181 case 'd':
182 len = mini_itoa(
183 longflag == 0 ? (long)va_arg(
184 va, int) :
185 va_arg(va, long),
186 10, 0, (ch == 'u'), bf, zero_pad);
187 _puts(bf, len, &b);
188 longflag = 0;
189 break;
190 case 'x':
191 case 'X':
192 len = mini_itoa(
193 longflag == 0 ? (unsigned long)va_arg(
194 va, unsigned int) :
195 va_arg(va, unsigned long),
196 16, (ch == 'X'), 1, bf, zero_pad);
197 _puts(bf, len, &b);
198 longflag = 0;
199 break;
200
201 case 'c':
202 _putc((char)(va_arg(va, int)), &b);
203 break;
204
205 case 's':
206 ptr = va_arg(va, char *);
207 _puts(ptr, strlen(ptr), &b);
208 break;
209
210 default:
211 _putc(ch, &b);
212 break;
213 }
214 }
215 }
216end:
217 return b.pbuffer - b.buffer;
218}
219
220int vprintf(const char *fmt, va_list _va)
221{
222 va_list va;
223 va_copy(va, _va);
224
225 int ret;
226 char buff[256];
227
228 ret = mini_vsnprintf(buff, 256, fmt, va);
229
230 buff[ret] = '\0';
231
232 sys_write(buff);
233 sys_reflush();
234
235 return ret;
236}
237
238int printf(const char *fmt, ...)
239{
240 int ret = 0;
241 va_list va;
242
243 va_start(va, fmt);
244 ret = vprintf(fmt, va);
245 va_end(va);
246
247 return ret;
248}

67{

85 while (*dest != '\0') {
86 dest++;
87 }
88 while (*src) {
89 *dest++ = *src++;
90 }
91
92 *dest = '\0';
93
94 return tmp;
95}

6static long invoke_syscall(long number, long p0, long p1, long p2, long p3, long p4)
7{
8 register long a0 asm("a0") = p0;
9 register long a1 asm("a1") = p1;
10 register long a2 asm("a2") = p2;
11 register long a3 asm("a3") = p3;
12 register long a4 asm("a4") = p4;
13 register long a7 asm("a7") = number;
14 asm volatile ("ecall" : "+r"(a0) : "r"(a1), "r"(a2), "r"(a3),
15 "r"(a4), "r"(a7) : "memory");
16 return a0;
17}

1/* ELF -> flat course disk image. Metadata matches the Project 1 layout.
2 * PT_LOAD segments retain their relative virtual-address offsets; holes
3 * are zero-filled. BSS is initialized by kernel/user startup code. */
4#include <elf.h>
5#include <stdint.h>
6#include <stdio.h>
7#include <stdlib.h>
8#include <string.h>
9#include <stdarg.h>
10#include <limits.h>
11
12#define TASK_MAXNUM 16
13#define TASK_NAME_LEN 32
14#define TASK_SIZE 0x10000UL
15#define TASK_BASE 0x52000000UL
16#define KERNEL_BASE 0x50201000UL
17#define BOOT_BASE 0x50200000UL
18#define SECTOR 512
19#define TASK_NUM_LOC 0x1f6
20#define APP_INFO_LOC 0x1f8
21#define OS_SIZE_LOC 0x1fc
22
23typedef struct {
24 char task_name[TASK_NAME_LEN];
25 uint32_t offset;
26 uint32_t size;
27 uint64_t entrypoint;
28} task_info_t;
29_Static_assert(sizeof(task_info_t) == 48, "disk ABI");
30static int extended;
31
32static void die(const char *fmt, ...)
33{
34 va_list ap;
35 va_start(ap, fmt);
36 vfprintf(stderr, fmt, ap);
37 va_end(ap);
38 fputc('\n', stderr);
39 exit(1);
40}
41static void read_at(FILE *fp, uint64_t offset, void *data, size_t size)
42{
43 if (offset > LONG_MAX || fseek(fp, (long)offset, SEEK_SET) ||
44 fread(data, 1, size, fp) != size) die("invalid/truncated ELF");
45}
46static void write_at(FILE *fp, uint64_t offset, const void *data, size_t size)
47{
48 if (offset > LONG_MAX || fseek(fp, (long)offset, SEEK_SET) ||
49 fwrite(data, 1, size, fp) != size) die("image write failed");
50}
51static uint32_t append_elf(FILE *img, const char *path, uint64_t expected,
52 uint64_t max_mem, uint64_t *entry)
53{
54 FILE *fp = fopen(path, "rb");
55 if (!fp) die("cannot open %s", path);
56 Elf64_Ehdr eh;
57 read_at(fp, 0, &eh, sizeof(eh));
58 if (memcmp(eh.e_ident, ELFMAG, SELFMAG) ||
59 eh.e_ident[EI_CLASS] != ELFCLASS64 || eh.e_ident[EI_DATA] != ELFDATA2LSB ||
60 eh.e_machine != EM_RISCV || eh.e_type != ET_EXEC ||
61 eh.e_phentsize != sizeof(Elf64_Phdr) || !eh.e_phnum)
62 die("%s: expected a static little-endian RISC-V ELF64 executable", path);
63 if (eh.e_entry != expected) die("%s: unexpected entry 0x%lx", path, eh.e_entry);
64 unsigned char *flat = calloc(1, max_mem);
65 if (!flat) die("out of memory");
66 uint64_t span = 0;
67 int loaded = 0;
68 for (unsigned i = 0; i < eh.e_phnum; ++i) {
69 Elf64_Phdr ph;
70 read_at(fp, eh.e_phoff + (uint64_t)i * sizeof(ph), &ph, sizeof(ph));
71 if (ph.p_type != PT_LOAD || !ph.p_memsz) continue;
72 if (ph.p_vaddr < expected || ph.p_filesz > ph.p_memsz ||
73 ph.p_vaddr - expected > max_mem ||
74 ph.p_memsz > max_mem - (ph.p_vaddr - expected))
75 die("%s: PT_LOAD outside its reserved memory", path);
76 uint64_t delta = ph.p_vaddr - expected;
77 if (ph.p_filesz) {
78 read_at(fp, ph.p_offset, flat + delta, ph.p_filesz);
79 uint64_t end = delta + ph.p_filesz;
80 if (end > span) span = end;
81 loaded = 1;
82 }
83 }
84 if (!loaded || !span || span > UINT32_MAX) die("%s: no loadable data", path);
85 if (fwrite(flat, 1, span, img) != span) die("image write failed");
86 free(flat);
87 fclose(fp);
88 *entry = eh.e_entry;
89 if (extended) printf("%s: entry=0x%lx, file span=%lu bytes\n", path, *entry, span);
90 return (uint32_t)span;
91}
92int main(int argc, char **argv)
93{
94 if (argc > 1 && !strcmp(argv[1], "--extended")) {
95 extended = 1;
96 --argc; ++argv;
97 }
98 int count = argc - 3;
99 if (count < 1 || count > TASK_MAXNUM)
100 die("usage: createimage [--extended] bootblock main app... (1..16 apps)");
101 FILE *img = fopen("image", "wb+");
102 if (!img) die("cannot create image");
103 uint64_t entry;
104 uint32_t boot_size = append_elf(img, argv[1], BOOT_BASE, TASK_NUM_LOC, &entry);
105 for (uint32_t i = boot_size; i < SECTOR; ++i)
106 if (fputc(0, img) == EOF) die("image write failed");
107 /* Boot size field is still bytes, not sectors, matching Project 1. */
108 uint32_t kernel_size = append_elf(img, argv[2], KERNEL_BASE,
109 0x50500000UL - KERNEL_BASE, &entry);
110 if (kernel_size > UINT16_MAX)
111 die("kernel exceeds the 16-bit byte-count field (%u bytes)", kernel_size);
112 task_info_t tasks[TASK_MAXNUM] = {0};
113 for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
114 const char *path = argv[i + 3];
115 const char *base = strrchr(path, '/');
116 base = base ? base + 1 : path;
117 if (!*base || strlen(base) >= TASK_NAME_LEN) die("invalid task name");
118 for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j)
119 if (!strcmp(tasks[j].task_name, base)) die("duplicate task name");
120 strcpy(tasks[i].task_name, base);
121 long pos = ftell(img);
122 if (pos < 0 || (unsigned long)pos > UINT32_MAX) die("image too large");
123 tasks[i].offset = (uint32_t)pos;
124 tasks[i].size = append_elf(img, path, TASK_BASE + i * TASK_SIZE,
125 TASK_SIZE, &tasks[i].entrypoint);
126 }
127 long pos = ftell(img);
128 if (pos < 0 || (unsigned long)pos > UINT32_MAX) die("image too large");
129 uint32_t app_offset = (uint32_t)pos;
130 if (fwrite(tasks, sizeof(*tasks), count, img) != (size_t)count)
131 die("metadata write failed");
132 /* Pad the image tail so the BIOS can safely read its final sector. */
133 long end = ftell(img);
134 if (end < 0) die("image offset failed");
135 while (end++ % SECTOR) if (fputc(0, img) == EOF) die("image write failed");
136 uint16_t n = count, bytes = kernel_size;
137 uint8_t signature[] = {0x55, 0xaa};
138 write_at(img, TASK_NUM_LOC, &n, sizeof(n));
139 write_at(img, APP_INFO_LOC, &app_offset, sizeof(app_offset));
140 write_at(img, OS_SIZE_LOC, &bytes, sizeof(bytes));
141 write_at(img, 0x1fe, signature, sizeof(signature));
142 if (fclose(img)) die("image close failed");
143 printf("image: kernel=%u bytes, tasks=%d, app-info=%u\n", kernel_size, count, app_offset);
144 return 0;
145}

6import argparse, os, re, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
7from pathlib import Path
8
9ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
10parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
11parser.add_argument('--qemu', default='qemu-system-riscv64')
12parser.add_argument('--cross-prefix', default='riscv64-linux-gnu-')
13parser.add_argument('--stage', type=int, choices=[1,2,3,4], default=4)
14parser.add_argument('--tasks', default=None)
15parser.add_argument('--seconds', type=float, default=7)

17parser.add_argument('--log', type=Path, default=Path('host-qemu.log'))
18args = parser.parse_args()
19def run(cmd, **kw):
20 subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, **kw)
21with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='p2-smoke-') as tmp:
22 tree = Path(tmp)/'Project2'
23 shutil.copytree(ROOT, tree, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('build', '*.log', '__pycache__', '.git'))
24 for p in tree.rglob('*'):
25 if p.is_file() and (p.suffix in ('.c','.h','.S') or p.name=='Makefile'):
26 # Match full address literals, never shorter constants or firmware.
27 if 'host-qemu' in p.parts: continue
28 s = p.read_text()
29 def relocate(m):
30 n = int(m[0],16)
31 return hex(n+0x30000000) if 0x50000000 <= n < 0x53000000 else m[0]
32 p.write_text(re.sub(r'0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+',relocate,s))
33 tasks = args.tasks or {1:'coop1 coop2', 2:'mutex1 mutex2', 3:'sleep coop_timer', 4:'probe1 probe2'}[args.stage]
34 run(['make','image',f'CROSS_PREFIX={args.cross_prefix}',f'LAB_STAGE={args.stage}',f'TASKS={tasks}'],cwd=tree,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)

41 raw=result.stdout
42 raise RuntimeError(f'QEMU exited unexpectedly: {result.returncode}\n{raw[-1000:]!r}')
43 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
44 raw=e.stdout or b''
45 text=raw.decode(errors='replace')
46 args.log.write_text(text)
47 # VT100 replaces previously drawn characters. Reconstruct the screen
48 # after each control sequence to observe actual output, not raw substrings.
49 required={1:['[COOP 1] count=','[COOP 2] count='],2:['[MUTEX 1] acquired','[MUTEX 2] acquired','[MUTEX 1] release','[MUTEX 2] release'],3:['This task is to test sleep. (1)','[COOP TIMER] seconds=2'],4:['[PROBE 1] PASS','[PROBE 2] PASS']}[args.stage]
50 if args.tasks:
51 markers = {
52 'print1':'This task is to test scheduler.',
53 'print2':'This task is to test scheduler.',
54 'lock1':'Has acquired lock and running.',
55 'lock2':'Has acquired lock and running.',
56 'sleep':'This task is to test sleep. (1)',
57 'timer':'This is a thread to timing!', 'fly':'~~~~~',
58 'probe1':'[PROBE 1] PASS', 'probe2':'[PROBE 2] PASS',
59 'coop1':'[COOP 1] count=', 'coop2':'[COOP 2] count=',
60 'mutex1':'[MUTEX 1] acquired', 'mutex2':'[MUTEX 2] acquired',
61 'coop_timer':'[COOP TIMER] seconds=2'
62 }
63 required=[markers[task] for task in args.tasks.split()]
64 row_requirements={}
65 if args.tasks:
66 for task,row_number in [('print1',0),('print2',1),('lock1',2),('lock2',3)]:
67 if task in args.tasks.split():
68 row_requirements[row_number]=markers[task]
69 seen_rows=set()
70 found=set(); fault=False; events=[]
71 lines=[[' ']*160 for _ in range(80)]
72 row=col=0
73 def observe(r):
74 global fault
75 line=''.join(lines[r])
76 if r in row_requirements and row_requirements[r] in line: seen_rows.add(r)
77 for marker in required:
78 if marker in line: found.add(marker)
79 for probe in (1,2):
80 for event in ('start','cpu-loop-ok','lock-held','lock-release','PASS'):
81 marker=f'[PROBE {probe}] {event}'
82 if marker in line and marker not in events: events.append(marker)
83 if 'Assertion failed' in line or 'scause:' in line: fault=True
84 for token in re.split(r'(\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z])',text):
85 if token.startswith('\x1b['):
86 observe(row)
87 if token.endswith('H'):
88 vals=token[2:-1].split(';')
89 row=max(0,min(79,int(vals[0] or 1)-1))
90 col=max(0,min(159,int(vals[1] or 1)-1)) if len(vals)>1 else 0
91 elif token=='\x1b[2J': lines=[[' ']*160 for _ in range(80)]
92 else:
93 for ch in token:
94 if ch=='\n': observe(row); row=min(79,row+1)
95 elif ch=='\r': observe(row); col=0
96 elif ch.isprintable():
97 lines[row][col]=ch;col=min(159,col+1)
98 observe(row)
99 if fault: raise RuntimeError('guest exception/assertion; inspect log')
100 missing=[s for s in required if s not in found]
101 if set(row_requirements) != seen_rows: raise RuntimeError('missing per-task row evidence')
102 if missing: raise RuntimeError('missing guest evidence: '+repr(missing))
103 if args.stage == 4 and not args.tasks:
104 first_done=min(events.index(f'[PROBE {i}] cpu-loop-ok') for i in (1,2))
105 assert all(events.index(f'[PROBE {i}] start') < first_done for i in (1,2)), 'no evidence of asynchronous preemption'
106 print('guest events:', ', '.join(events))
107 print(f'PASS: relocated upstream-QEMU smoke stage {args.stage}; log={args.log}')

8def elf(path,base,segments,entry=None):
9 ident=b'\x7fELF'+bytes([2,1,1])+bytes(9)
10 hdr=struct.pack('<16sHHIQQQIHHHHHH',ident,2,243,1,base if entry is None else entry,64,0,0,64,56,len(segments),0,0,0)
11 offset=64+56*len(segments);ph=[];data=b''
12 for delta,blob,mem in segments:
13 ph.append(struct.pack('<IIQQQQQQ',1,7,offset,base+delta,base+delta,len(blob),mem,1))
14 data+=blob;offset+=len(blob)
15 path.write_bytes(hdr+b''.join(ph)+data)
16

27 tests+=1
28 return work
